jobs.title: R&D Internship for Magnetics Design in Power Electronic Converter Systems 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity At Hitachi Energy Research, we closely collaborate with business areas to develop foundations for the next generation of Power Grids products. Located in the proximity of Zurich, the research center employs more than 60 scientists from all over the world with cross-disciplinary expertise. In the Systems Integration and Physics Team we address the challenges and opportunities in enhancing grid flexibility and facilitating renewable energy proliferation. A key focus of our work is multi-physics modeling for power electronic systems, which plays a critical role in fast-growing applications such as electric vehicle charging, energy storage and renewables like wind and solar. In this context, we offer an 6 months internship position which provides the opportunity of working on real-world projects in an international team of research scientists. How you'll make an impact Extension of a MATLAB-based tool for systematic and comprehensive design and optimization of magnetic components in power electronic converters Design and comparison of different winding types Design and comparison of different core materials Implementation and testing of models. Documentation of studies and results in technical reports Adaption of the code architecture as necessary to maintain clarity and facilitate easy maintenance Collaboration with an international research team and experts in power electronics    Your background Enrolled in a Master degree program in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, computer sciences, or a similar discipline (completion of at least six semesters) Experience with MATLAB programming Familiar with magnetics in power electronic converters Enthusiastic, motivated and curious with good organizational skills and team spirit Highly conscientious professional with a strong sense of responsibility and excellent communication skills Fluency in English, written and spoken More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

jobs.title: Service Project & Tender Specialist 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity At our competence center “Power Converter Solutions”, we have a leading position in the development, manufacturing, installation, commissioning and maintenance of high-power electronic converters mainly for STATCOM and rail power supply systems. We also provide solutions for hydro pump stations and grid interties. With the help of our highly efficient converters, we contribute to the integration of renewable energies into the electrical grid of tomorrow and at the same time increase the overall system efficiency.  In this role, you will take ownership of driving and implementing the service sales strategy, identifying new business opportunities, and ensuring strong commercial outcomes across the full contract lifecycle. You will play a key role in developing competitive proposals, structuring contracts, and ensuring alignment with customer requirements, internal policies, and technical standards. Working at the intersection of sales, legal, finance, and engineering, you will contribute to sustainable business growth while optimizing both financial and operational performance. How you'll make an impact Drive and execute the service sales strategy while monitoring performance, identifying market trends to develop new business opportunities, and leading contract and proposal development aligned with customer requirements, budgets, and timelines Negotiate and define contract baselines, ensuring compliance while maximizing financial and operational performance Manage contract execution, including documenting and controlling changes and amendments Monitor contract performance, identifying deviations and driving corrective actions where needed Ensure accurate and timely execution of all commercial aspects in close collaboration with technical, financial, and legal stakeholders Support business development by providing expert advice on commercial and contractual topics, leveraging strong legal knowledge Your background Bachelor's degree or technical qualification (FH\/HF\/TS), preferably in electrical engineering, with knowledge of power electronics and\/or control technology Initial professional experience (2–3 years) in projects, tenders, contract management or a technical role with exposure to project or customer-facing work, with the ability to manage tasks independently Strong commercial mindset and interest in contract negotiation, with first exposure to or willingness to develop skills in contract, change, and claim management Basic understanding of legal terminology and contractual frameworks, or motivation to build up this knowledge in a commercial role Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset Ability to collaborate across functions and influence stakeholders in a complex environment Hands-on, customer-focused mindset with a strong drive to deliver results Proficiency in ERP systems (SAP SD\/CS preferred) and fluent in German and English More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Global SCM Material Sustainability Lead (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is seeking a Global SCM Material Sustainability Lead for the Business Unit Transformers to join our innovative and forward-thinking team. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end management of the Material Sustainability pillar, aligning methodologies for environmental impact assessments, defining processes, implementing initiatives, and monitoring progress across the business unit. This is your opportunity to align with business objectives and regulatory requirements, supporting the organization's sustainability goals and making a meaningful impact in the energy industry. How you will make an impact Contribute to the development of the business unit's supply chain sustainability strategy, focusing on material sustainability and alignment with business objectives. Monitor emerging material sustainability trends, regulatory changes, and customer requirements, integrating them into strategic and operational plans. Develop standardized process flows for material sustainability requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and effective implementation. Identify opportunities to enhance material sustainability, driving projects such as decarbonization efforts and improving practices with key global suppliers. Implement performance monitoring systems to track progress against material sustainability goals, enabling data-driven decisions and continuous improvement. Develop and maintain a comprehensive database of primary sustainability data for materials, ensuring accurate information and promoting adoption across the supply chain. This includes defining the data needed to enable consistent LCA\/EPD\/PCF assessments and comparable material-level impact evaluations. Engage with suppliers and cross-functional teams to guide strategic suppliers toward emission-zero goals and sustainable practices. Develop and deliver training on material sustainability topics, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and best practices across the SCM community. Align the BU Transformers methodologies for assessing material environmental impacts in line with evolving LCA\/EPD standards. Apply these methodologies to transformer-relevant materials and decisions by defining measurable requirements for suppliers and by supporting internal stakeholders with actionable guidance for material choices, claims, and customer requests. Your background Degree in Environmental Science, Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related field. Minimum of 10 years of experience in supply chain management with focus on sustainability, with proven leadership in strategy and roadmap creation, preferably within global or large-scale organizations. Strong expertise in materials sustainability standards such as ISO 14040\/14044, ISO 14067, the Greenhouse Gas Protocol, and related frameworks. Extensive experience with Life Cycle Assessments (LCA), Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs), and implementing global sustainability programs related to materials and suppliers. Strong leadership skills with a track record of developing and executing strategic initiatives in complex, international environments. Excellent communication, presentation, and influencing skills, with the ability to build relationships and inspire change at all organization levels.

Extensive experience with Life Cycle Assessments (LCA), Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs), and implementing global sustainability programs related to materials and suppliers. Strong leadership skills with a track record of developing and executing strategic initiatives in complex, international environments. Excellent communication, presentation, and influencing skills, with the ability to build relationships and inspire change at all organization levels.

jobs.title: Shift Equipment Maintenance Engineer – Etching 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity  Join our innovative team as a Shift Maintenance Engineer and play a critical role in the heart of semiconductor production! With a strong focus on etching processes, you'll work with cutting-edge technology to optimize system performance and ensure seamless operations. This is your opportunity to collaborate with experts, contribute to groundbreaking projects, and grow in a dynamic, high-tech environment. If you're passionate about precision and innovation, we want to hear from you!   How you'll make an impact  Maintain and optimize wet chemical and plasma etch equipment to ensure high availability  Troubleshoot and repair complex systems in collaboration with OEM partners  Plan and support preventive maintenance activities to improve tool performance  Manage spare parts and contribute to equipment upgrades and process improvements  Collaborate with engineering, R&D, and operations teams to support production goals  Create and maintain technical documentation and support data tracking in MES systems  Identify and implement improvements in tools, processes, and operational efficiency  Ensure compliance with HSE standards and promote a safe working environment  Your background  Technical vocational training in automation, electronics, or a related field (EFZ or equivalent)  2+ years of experience in equipment maintenance in semiconductor or similar industries  Strong technical knowledge in plasma tools (e.g. AMAT, LAM systems)  Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics, pneumatics, and vacuum systems  Ability to work in a team-oriented environment and within shift operations  Good communication skills in English (German is a plus)  More about us   You will join a dynamic and fast-paced production environment where teamwork, reliability, and technical excellence are key.  Working in a shift-based setup, you will be part of a highly skilled maintenance team supporting critical operations and advanced manufacturing processes.  This role offers hands-on experience with complex technologies and the opportunity to develop your technical skills while contributing directly to production stability and performance.

titleByLocale.it: Ingegnere di manutenzione dell'attrezzatura di spostamento – Etching 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
titleByLocale.fr: Ingénieur d'entretien de l'équipement de poste – Échéance 80 – 100% (f/m/d)

descriptionByLocale.it:
Mansioni - Mantenere e ottimizzare l'attrezzatura chimica e al plasma bagnati per garantire elevata disponibilità - Risoluzione dei problemi e sistemi complessi di riparazione in collaborazione con i partner OEM - Pianificare e sostenere attività di manutenzione preventiva per migliorare le prestazioni degli utensili - Gestire i pezzi di ricambio e contribuire agli aggiornamenti delle attrezzature e miglioramenti dei processi - Collaborare con team di ingegneria, R&D e operazioni per sostenere gli obiettivi di produzione - Creare e mantenere la documentazione tecnica e supportare il monitoraggio dei dati nei sistemi MES - Identificare e implementare miglioramenti in strumenti, processi ed efficienza operativa - Garantire il rispetto degli standard HSE e promuovere un ambiente di lavoro sicuro
• Requisiti - Formazione professionale tecnica nell'automazione, nell'elettronica o in un settore relativo (EFZ o equivalente) - 2+ anni di esperienza nella manutenzione delle attrezzature in semiconduttori o industrie simili - Forte conoscenza tecnica negli strumenti al plasma (ad es. sistemi AMAT, LAM) - Solida comprensione dell'elettronica, meccanica, pneumatica e sistemi di vuoto - Capacità di lavorare in un ambiente orientato al team e all'interno delle operazioni a turni - Buone capacità di comunicazione in inglese (il tedesco è un plus) Cosa? - Ti unirai a un ambiente di produzione dinamico e veloce in cui il lavoro di squadra, l'affidabilità e l'eccellenza tecnica sono fondamentali. - Lavorando in una configurazione a turni, sarete parte di un team di manutenzione altamente qualificato che supporta operazioni critiche e processi produttivi avanzati. - Questo ruolo offre esperienza pratica con tecnologie complesse e l'opportunità di sviluppare le tue competenze tecniche, contribuendo direttamente alla stabilità e alle prestazioni di produzione. Contatto - Unisciti al nostro team innovativo come Ingegnere di Manutenzione Shift e gioca un ruolo fondamentale nel cuore della produzione di semiconduttori! - Con una forte attenzione ai processi di incisione, lavorerai con tecnologia all'avanguardia per ottimizzare le prestazioni del sistema e garantire operazioni senza interruzioni. - Questa è la tua opportunità di collaborare con gli esperti, contribuire a progetti innovativi e crescere in un ambiente dinamico e high-tech. - Se siete appassionati di precisione e innovazione, vogliamo sentirvi!
descriptionByLocale.en:
## Mansioni - Maintain and optimize wet chemical and plasma etch equipment to ensure high availability - Troubleshoot and repair complex systems in collaboration with OEM partners - Plan and support preventive maintenance activities to improve tool performance - Manage spare parts and contribute to equipment upgrades and process improvements - Collaborate with engineering, R&D, and operations teams to support production goals - Create and maintain technical documentation and support data tracking in MES systems - Identify and implement improvements in tools, processes, and operational efficiency - Ensure compliance with HSE standards and promote a safe working environment ##
• Requisiti - Technical vocational training in automation, electronics, or a related field (EFZ or equivalent) - 2+ years of experience in equipment maintenance in semiconductor or similar industries - Strong technical knowledge in plasma tools (e.g. AMAT, LAM systems) - Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics, pneumatics, and vacuum systems - Ability to work in a team-oriented environment and within shift operations - Good communication skills in English (German is a plus) ##
• Cosa offriamo - You will join a dynamic and fast-paced production environment where teamwork, reliability, and technical excellence are key. - Working in a shift-based setup, you will be part of a highly skilled maintenance team supporting critical operations and advanced manufacturing processes. - This role offers hands-on experience with complex technologies and the opportunity to develop your technical skills while contributing directly to production stability and performance. ## Contatto - Join our innovative team as a Shift Maintenance Engineer and play a critical role in the heart of semiconductor production! - With a strong focus on etching processes, you'll work with cutting-edge technology to optimize system performance and ensure seamless operations. - This is your opportunity to collaborate with experts, contribute to groundbreaking projects, and grow in a dynamic, high-tech environment. - If you're passionate about precision and innovation, we want to hear from you!
descriptionByLocale.de:
Mansion - Bewahren und optimieren nasse chemische und Plasma-Ätzgeräte, um hohe Verfügbarkeit zu gewährleisten - Fehlerbehebung und Reparatur komplexer Systeme in Zusammenarbeit mit OEM-Partnern - Planen und unterstützen vorbeugende Wartungsarbeiten zur Verbesserung der Werkzeugleistung - Ersatzteile verwalten und zu Anlagen-Upgrades und Prozessverbesserungen beitragen - Zusammenarbeit mit Ingenieur-, FuE- und Betriebsteams zur Unterstützung von Produktionszielen - Erstellung und Pflege von technischen Dokumentationen und Support-Datenverfolgung in MES-Systemen - Verbesserung von Werkzeugen, Prozessen und betrieblicher Effizienz identifizieren und implementieren - Gewährleistung der Einhaltung von HSE-Standards und Förderung eines sicheren Arbeitsumfelds Voraussetzungen - Technische Berufsbildung in Automatisierung, Elektronik oder einem verwandten Bereich (EFZ oder Äquivalent) - 2+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Wartung von Geräten in Halbleitern oder ähnlichen Industrien - Starkes technisches Wissen in Plasmawerkzeugen (z.B. AMAT, LAM-Systeme) - Solides Verständnis von Elektronik, Mechanik, Pneumatik und Vakuumsystemen - Fähigkeit, in einem teamorientierten Umfeld und innerhalb von Schichtbetrieben zu arbeiten - Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten auf Englisch (Deutsch ist ein Plus)
• Cosa offriamo - Sie werden sich einer dynamischen und schnellen Produktionsumgebung anschließen, in der Teamarbeit, Zuverlässigkeit und technische Exzellenz entscheidend sind. - Sie arbeiten in einem Schichtaufbau, werden Teil eines hochqualifizierten Wartungsteams sein, das kritische Operationen und fortgeschrittene Fertigungsprozesse unterstützt. - Diese Rolle bietet praktische Erfahrungen mit komplexen Technologien und die Möglichkeit, Ihre technischen Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln und direkt zur Produktionsstabilität und Leistungsfähigkeit beizutragen. Contattoo - Begleiten Sie unser innovatives Team als Shift Maintenance Engineer und spielen Sie eine wichtige Rolle im Herzen der Halbleiterproduktion! - Mit einem starken Fokus auf Ätzprozessen arbeiten Sie mit modernster Technologie, um die Systemleistung zu optimieren und einen reibungslosen Betrieb zu gewährleisten. - Dies ist Ihre Gelegenheit, mit Experten zusammenzuarbeiten, zu bahnbrechenden Projekten beizutragen und in einem dynamischen, High-Tech-Umfeld zu wachsen. - Wenn Sie Leidenschaft für Präzision und Innovation sind, wollen wir von Ihnen hören!
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Mansioni - Maintenez et optimisez les équipements chimiques et plasmatiques humides pour assurer une grande disponibilité - Systèmes complexes de dépannage et de réparation en collaboration avec les partenaires OEM - Planifier et soutenir les activités de maintenance préventive pour améliorer la performance des outils - Gérer les pièces de rechange et contribuer à la modernisation du matériel et à l ' amélioration des procédés - Collaborer avec les équipes du génie, de la R-D et des opérations pour appuyer les objectifs de production - Créer et maintenir la documentation technique et le suivi des données dans les systèmes MES - Identifier et mettre en oeuvre des améliorations dans les outils, les processus et l'efficacité opérationnelle - Assurer le respect des normes HSE et promouvoir un environnement de travail sûr
• Requisiti - Formation professionnelle technique en automatisation, en électronique ou dans un domaine connexe (EFZ ou équivalent) - 2+ ans d'expérience dans l'entretien des équipements dans les industries semi-conducteurs ou similaires - Forte connaissance technique des outils plasma (par exemple AMAT, systèmes LAM) - Compréhension solide des systèmes électroniques, mécaniques, pneumatiques et de vide - Capacité de travailler dans un environnement axé sur l'équipe et dans le cadre d'opérations par équipes - Bonnes compétences en communication en anglais (l'allemand est un plus)
• Cosa offriamo - Vous rejoindrez un environnement de production dynamique et rapide où le travail d'équipe, la fiabilité et l'excellence technique sont essentiels. - Travaillant dans une configuration basée sur le poste, vous ferez partie d'une équipe de maintenance hautement qualifiée soutenant des opérations critiques et des processus de fabrication avancés. - Ce rôle offre une expérience pratique avec des technologies complexes et la possibilité de développer vos compétences techniques tout en contribuant directement à la stabilité de la production et aux performances. Contatto - Rejoignez notre équipe innovante en tant qu'ingénieur de maintenance de quart et jouez un rôle crucial au cœur de la production de semi-conducteurs ! - Avec une forte focalisation sur les processus de gravure, vous travaillerez avec une technologie de pointe pour optimiser les performances du système et assurer des opérations sans faille. - C'est l'occasion de collaborer avec des experts, de contribuer à des projets novateurs et de grandir dans un environnement dynamique et de haute technologie. - Si vous êtes passionné par la précision et l'innovation, nous voulons vous entendre !

jobs.title: Functional Lead Secondary Engineering Standardization Team 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, is renowned worldwide as a specialist for power transmission and distribution. Our unit Gas Insulated Switchgears (GIS), based in Zürich-Oerlikon, is active in the development and production of gas insulated switching systems. We ensure the high reliability of our systems by using state-of-the-art development tools and methods. For our business unit High Voltage Products we are looking for a Functional Lead of the Standardization Team in Secondary Engineering. In this challenging position you will take over the functional lead for the standardization team to drive forward the product standardization and improvements. You will work closely with the Secondary Engineering team in Switzerland, Germany and India and develop a Standardization Roadmap that guides the development of our product for the future. Together with the standardization team, you will ensure successful implementation of improvements, such as releases of new templates and engineering guidelines that enables Engineering to deliver their projects effectively and in high quality. How you'll make an impact Lead functionally the Secondary Engineering Standardization Team including the daily management of tasks, planning and balancing of team workload, ensuring progress, transparency, and effective utilization of team capacity and development of required competences the team Define of GIS Secondary Engineering design standards through the development of templates and design guidelines with the support of the standardization team and experts Develop, maintain and regularly update of the Secondary Engineering Standardization Roadmap in collaboration with the Standardization team members, Key stakeholders within Secondary Engineering and other departments Engage in the Quality process and Continuous Improvement Cycles of the GIS organization and actively collaborate with other engineering teams and stakeholders to discuss, evaluate and align improvements, and to prioritize them for the implementation Execute and technically lead improvement tasks from the Standardization roadmap individually Drive the standardization and harmonization of E3 templates to provide an efficient and high-quality basis for project-specific schematics Your background Electrical engineering background Demonstrated ability to lead successfully, either in management position or in challenging and complex projects Solid experience in engineering of Secondary Equipment (LCCs) as Secondary Engineering PM Experience of the corresponding tools used for Secondary Engineering Readiness to take over role as functional leadership within a team.   Proven experience in Project Management, Certification e.g. as PMP is a plus Fluency in English. German or any other language is a plus The job owner lives an innovative and performance-oriented thinking as well as following the values of Hitachi Energy and makes a personal contribution to a good working atmosphere More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'occasione Hitachi Energy, prodotti ad alta tensione, è rinomata in tutto il mondo come specialista per la trasmissione e la distribuzione di energia. La nostra unità Gas isolato Switchgears (GIS), con sede a Zürich-Oerlikon, è attiva nello sviluppo e nella produzione di sistemi di commutazione isolata a gas. Garantiamo l'elevata affidabilità dei nostri sistemi utilizzando strumenti e metodi di sviluppo all'avanguardia. Per il nostro business unit Prodotti ad alta tensione stiamo cercando un piombo funzionale del team di standardizzazione in ingegneria secondaria. In questa posizione impegnativa si prende il sopravvento funzionale per il team di standardizzazione di guidare avanti la standardizzazione dei prodotti e miglioramenti. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con il team Secondary Engineering in Svizzera, Germania e India e sviluppare una Standardization Roadmap che guida lo sviluppo del nostro prodotto per il futuro. Insieme al team di standardizzazione, garantirai una corretta implementazione dei miglioramenti, come le versioni di nuovi modelli e linee guida ingegneristiche che consentono a Engineering di fornire i loro progetti in modo efficace e di alta qualità. Come farete un impatto Lead funzionalily the Secondary Engineering Standardization Team tra cui la gestione quotidiana dei compiti, la pianificazione e il bilanciamento del carico di lavoro di squadra, garantire il progresso, la trasparenza e l'utilizzo efficace della capacità del team e lo sviluppo individualmente delle competenze richieste il team Definire di GIS Secondary Engineering standard design standards attraverso lo sviluppo di modelli e linee guida di progettazione con il supporto del team di standardizzazione e gli esperti Sviluppare, mantenere e aggiornare regolarmente gli standardizzazione del team Sfondo di ingegneria elettrica Capacità dimostrata di condurre con successo, sia in posizione di gestione o in progetti impegnativi e complessi Esperienza solida in ingegneria di Secondary Equipment (LCCs) come Secondary Engineering PM Esperienza dei corrispondenti strumenti utilizzati per Secondary Engineering Readiness di assumere il ruolo di leadership funzionale all'interno di un team. Esperienza comprovata nella gestione dei progetti, certificazione ad esempio come PMP è un plus Fluency in inglese. Tedesco o qualsiasi altra lingua è un plus Il proprietario del lavoro vive un pensiero innovativo e orientato alle prestazioni, oltre a seguire i valori di Hitachi Energy e dà un contributo personale ad una buona atmosfera lavorativa Maggiori informazioni su di noi Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.

jobs.description:
The opportunity Hitachi Energy is a leading global specialist in power transmission and distribution. In our services division, we work to make complex systems efficient, reliable and future-proof. To further develop our digital solutions, we are looking for a committed individual in the field of low-code development with a focus on the Microsoft Power Platform. In this role, you will work alongside an experienced team to design modern applications and develop your own solutions that make our processes smarter and more transparent. If you are passionate about technology, enjoy hands-on work and want to see how your ideas create real added value, we look forward to hearing from you. How you'll make an impact Familiarization with existing applications based on the Microsoft Power Platform Supporting the further expansion and development of the application landscape in the service sector Analysing business processes and identifying opportunities for automation Developing low-code applications based on business requirements Collaborating with developers and service departments Supporting the documentation of applications and processes Your background Currently studying Computer Science, Business Informatics or a similar subject Initial experience with the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, etc.) or comparable low-code technologies Basic understanding of programming and digital applications and a structured way of working  Interest in operational business processes, ideally in the service or industrial sector Independent as well as team player with a willingness to learn and a strong motivation to develop further Good command of German and English More about us We are a technology‑oriented company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated support, and a supportive, inclusive environment in which you can develop both personally and professionally. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non‑EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate confirming that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

The opportunity Hitachi Energy is a leading global specialist in power transmission and distribution. In our services division, we work to make complex systems efficient, reliable and future-proof. To further develop our digital solutions, we are looking for a committed individual in the field of low-code development with a focus on the Microsoft Power Platform. In this role, you will work alongside an experienced team to design modern applications and develop your own solutions that make our processes smarter and more transparent. If you are passionate about technology, enjoy hands-on work and want to see how your ideas create real added value, we look forward to hearing from you. How you'll make an impact Familiarization with existing applications based on the Microsoft Power Platform Supporting the further expansion and development of the application landscape in the service sector Analysing business processes and identifying opportunities for automation Developing low-code applications based on business requirements Collaborating with developers and service departments Supporting the documentation of applications and processes Your background Currently studying Computer Science, Business Informatics or a similar subject Initial experience with the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, etc.) or comparable low-code technologies Basic understanding of programming and digital applications and a structured way of working Interest in operational business processes, ideally in the service or industrial sector Independent as well as team player with a willingness to learn and a strong motivation to develop further Good command of German and English More about us We are a technology‑oriented company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing.
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated support, and a supportive, inclusive environment in which you can develop both personally and professionally. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non‑EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate confirming that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Hitachi Energy ist ein weltweit führender Spezialist für Stromübertragung und -verteilung. In unserem Servicebereich arbeiten wir daran, komplexe Systeme effizient, zuverlässig und zukunftssicher zu gestalten. Um unsere digitalen Lösungen weiter zu entwickeln, suchen wir ein engagiertes Individuum im Bereich der Low-Code-Entwicklung mit Schwerpunkt auf der Microsoft Power Platform. In dieser Rolle arbeiten Sie mit einem erfahrenen Team zusammen, um moderne Anwendungen zu entwickeln und eigene Lösungen zu entwickeln, die unsere Prozesse intelligenter und transparenter machen. Wenn Sie leidenschaftlich über Technologie, genießen Sie die praktische Arbeit und wollen sehen, wie Ihre Ideen einen echten Mehrwert schaffen, freuen wir uns auf das Hören von Ihnen. Wie Sie einen Einfluss auf die Familiarisierung mit bestehenden Anwendungen auf der Basis der Microsoft Power Platform Unterstützen Sie die Weiterentwicklung und Entwicklung der Anwendungslandschaft im Servicebereich Analyse von Geschäftsprozessen und Identifikation von Automatisierungs-Möglichkeiten Entwicklung von Low-Code-Anwendungen basierend auf Geschäftsanforderungen Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklern und Service-Abteilungen Unterstützung der Dokumentation von Anwendungen und Prozessen
• Wir bieten flexible Arbeitsbedingungen, engagierte Unterstützung und eine unterstützende, inklusive Umgebung, in der Sie sich sowohl persönlich als auch professionell entwickeln können. Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung, einschließlich eines kurzen Briefes und einer Abschrift von Aufzeichnungen, zusammen mit Ihrem Lebenslauf. Nicht-EU\/EFTA-Bürger, beachten Sie bitte, dass ein offizielles Hochschulzertifikat erforderlich ist, das bestätigt, dass ein Praktikum ein Pflichtteil Ihres Studiums ist.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'opportunité Hitachi Energy est un spécialiste mondial de la transmission et de la distribution d'électricité. Dans notre division des services, nous travaillons à rendre les systèmes complexes efficaces, fiables et à l'épreuve du futur. Pour développer davantage nos solutions numériques, nous recherchons une personne engagée dans le domaine du développement de codes bas avec un accent sur la plate-forme d'alimentation Microsoft. Dans ce rôle, vous travaillerez avec une équipe expérimentée pour concevoir des applications modernes et développer vos propres solutions qui rendent nos processus plus intelligents et plus transparents. Si vous êtes passionné par la technologie, profitez du travail pratique et voulez voir comment vos idées créent une réelle valeur ajoutée, nous avons hâte de vous entendre. Comment vous ferez un impact Familiarisation avec les applications existantes basées sur la plateforme Microsoft Power Soutenir l'expansion et le développement du paysage des applications dans le secteur des services Analyser les processus d'affaires et identifier les possibilités d'automatisation Développer des applications à faible code en fonction des besoins d'affaires Collaborer avec les développeurs et les départements de services Soutenir la documentation des applications et des processus Vos antécédents Étudier actuellement l'informatique, l'informatique commerciale ou un sujet similaire Expérience initiale avec la plate-forme Microsoft Power (Power Apps, Power Automate, etc.) ou des technologies à faible code comparables Compréhension de base de la programmation et des applications numériques et une façon structurée de travailler Intérêt dans les processus opérationnels, idéalement dans le secteur des services ou de l'industrie Indépendant ainsi que joueur d'équipe avec une volonté d'apprendre et une forte motivation pour développer davantage Bonne maîtrise de l'allemand et de l'anglais Plus sur nous Nous sommes une entreprise technologique avec un fort accent sur l'innovation, l'amélioration continue et la fabrication durable.
• Nous offrons des conditions de travail flexibles, un soutien dédié et un environnement favorable et inclusif dans lequel vous pouvez développer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature, y compris une brève lettre de présentation et une transcription des dossiers, ainsi que votre CV. Citoyens non-UE\/AELE, veuillez noter qu'un certificat universitaire officiel confirmant qu'un stage est une partie obligatoire de vos études est requis.

jobs.title: Designer Bushings 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The Opportunity Join a dynamic team at the forefront of high-voltage technology, where your creativity and precision will shape the future of custom-engineered bushings. As a Designer, you'll take ownership of innovative mechanical solutions, optimize designs for performance and manufacturability, and contribute directly to cutting-edge development projects. This is your chance to work hands-on with advanced tools like Creo and SAP, while driving continuous improvement in a collaborative, forward-thinking environment. If you're passionate about engineering excellence and ready to make a tangible impact, this role is made for you. How you'll make an impact Development and design of customer-specific high-voltage bushings Maintenance and creation of technical documentation, bills of materials, and master data in the SAP system Implementation of technical specifications and application of dimensional, form, and positional tolerances Optimization of existing designs with regard to efficiency, manufacturability, and quality Independent execution of smaller development projects or tool improvements Support in the continuous improvement of our processes and products Your background Completed training as a design engineer (EFZ) or a comparable qualification 3 to 5 years of professional experience in mechanical design or product design Solid knowledge of 3D design, ideally with Creo (PTC) Independent, reliable, and solution-oriented working style High level of initiative and sense of responsibility Very good German skills, both written and spoken; English skills are an advantage More about us   Our flexible work practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: R&D Team Manager – Next Generation Grids Transformers 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity  Hitachi Energy is seeking an experienced and motivated R&D Team Manager to lead our Next Generation Grids Transformers team in Geneva, Switzerland.   In this role, you will manage a team of 5+ engineers and drive the development of advanced and innovative technologies, including medium frequency transformers and power electronics enhanced transformers. You will combine people leadership with strong technical guidance and project ownership, contributing to the execution of R&D strategy in a global environment.  How you'll make an impact     Lead, develop, and motivate an international R&D team of 5+ engineers with know-how in medium frequency transformers, power converters and lab testing Provide technical leadership and support the team in solving complex engineering challenges  Contribute to R&D strategy and technology direction, including development of roadmaps for the New Generation Grids Transformers product line  Plan, drive, and deliver R&D projects, ensuring alignment with scope, timelines, and quality targets  Collaborate closely with global R&D teams, engineering functions, and external partners  Manage project resources and budgets to maximize impact and operational efficiency Site R&D laboratory and infrastructure responsibility, including driving expansion plans  Introduce and implement new tools, technologies, and processes to improve performance  Your background    Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering or related field  Several years of industrial experience in product development, or technology management  Strong technical background in transformers and power converters  Proven experience in project management within R&D or product development  Experience in leading technical teams (line or project leadership) and working in international and cross-functional environments  Strong communication skills in English (French is a plus) as well as stakeholder engagement capabilities  More about us You will join a collaborative and international R&D environment at the forefront of next-generation grid technologies. Working in Geneva, you will contribute to innovative transformer solutions that support the energy transition and the development of more flexible and sustainable power systems. Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow

descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité En tant que spécialiste de la santé et de la sécurité des employés et de l'environnement de l'usine, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la participation au développement de la santé et de la sécurité des employés, en mettant l'accent sur le thème environnemental, mais en offrant un bon soutien aux activités de santé et de sécurité. Les principales tâches du côté environnemental seront liées à la sauvegarde de l'intégrité environnementale de notre site et à la promotion de nos ambitions en matière de durabilité. Dans ce rôle, vous assurerez le plein respect de toutes les lois, règlements et permis environnementaux pertinents, tout en favorisant des relations solides avec les intervenants communautaires et les autorités environnementales. Vous allez élaborer, mettre en oeuvre et maintenir des politiques et des procédures environnementales solides qui favorisent la reddition de comptes dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. En effectuant des évaluations des risques environnementaux, en offrant une formation sur les pratiques de durabilité et en menant des initiatives qui améliorent l'efficacité des ressources, vous contribuerez directement à réduire l'empreinte environnementale de l'usine et à soutenir l'excellence opérationnelle à long terme. Pour ce qui est de la santé et de la sécurité, vous devrez appuyer les principales activités de développement de la santé et de la sécurité organisées par le gestionnaire de l'ESH, afin d'obtenir des résultats en fonction des attentes de la direction. Veuillez soumettre votre candidature en anglais. Comment vous ferez un impact Assurer la conformité réglementaire avec le droit suisse de l'environnement et les cadres connexes (USG\/EPA, LRV\/OAPC, GSchG\/WPA, VVEA, ChemA\/ChemO), y compris la gestion des permis et la coordination avec les autorités cantonales (BAFU) Diriger les évaluations de l'impact environnemental pour les nouvelles lignes de production, les changements d'usine et les modifications, assurer l'alignement sur les politiques environnementales internes Gérer les déchets et les éliminations, y compris la ségrégation, la traçabilité, les registres, les audits des fournisseurs et tous les flux spéciaux de déchets, tout en appuyant les initiatives de réduction des déchets et d'amélioration de la VVEA Surveiller la conformité chimique, y compris ChemA, ChemO, ORRChem, CLP, gérer et maintenir les exigences de la SDD en matière de sécurité, et les notifications de nouvelles substances Soutenir la manutention et l'entreposage sécuritaires des marchandises dangereuses (DG) en coordonnant avec les ministères concernés et en assurant la conformité continue Plan et des vérifications et inspections environnementales, en identifiant les domaines d'amélioration et en veillant à des mesures En ce qui a trait à la santé et à la sécurité, vous êtes tenu d'appuyer le gestionnaire de l'ESH dans la gestion des activités de production et de l'équipement ayant les normes de sécurité les plus élevées, tant sur le plan pratique que sur la préparation de la documentation. Appuyer les activités de rapport sur les ESE requises par les intervenants internes du gouvernement ou d'Hitachi Energy. jobs.description: The opportunity We are looking for a Service Sales Engineer for our Traction Transformers Service Business Unit, in Geneva (Switzerland). Reporting to the Traction Service Sales and Marketing Manager you will support the Sales organization and customers throughout the sales process in the assigned area. You will be part of the Sales Team that focuses on Traction Transformer Service in Europe. As Service Sales Engineer it is your exciting task to facilitate the sustainable mobility transition by a cutting-edge rail product and rail service portfolio for rolling stock equipment. In this team, you will work with international peers having many years of experience within the on-board traction transformer service business for rolling stock equipment. Based in Geneva, the role will assume responsibility for the rail customers in Europe (OEM train manufacturers, rail operators, leasing companies). If you are a highly skilled and motivated engineer looking to join a dynamic team, we encourage you to apply. How you'll make an impact Supporting the Sales team and customers throughout the sales process, while developing new and existing business by increasing internal and external knowledge of products and market Preparing technical offer in accordance with Unit portfolio and customer need. Clarifying technical and commercial aspects of the offer Participating in sales strategy discussions, assigning short- and long-term goals and negotiating the various Product Group sales budgets and marketing plans Identifying customer needs and competitor offers through market analysis, ensuring efficient marketing actions and communications demonstrate the value proposition of the products, systems, service and packages Supporting the area Sales organization\/customers in determining the most technically appropriate and cost-effective solutions and providing technical support, product presentations and product\/solution\/service-related training Taking ownership of specific customer cases to ensure efficient customer issue resolution and analyzing the root cause of any lost proposals, to increase future competitiveness Performing sales performance reviews, proposing recovery plans in cases of potential order shortfalls and providing regular sales activity reports to assist in production planning Living core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business Your background Bachelor's degree in engineering and more than 2 years of experience in direct sales and sales management Knowledge of rail rolling stock market and rail customers (OEM train manufacturers, rail operators, leasing companies) is an advantage Fluent in French and English, both written and spoken. Other languages are an advantage Experience in business development, account management and cross-selling across systems, solutions, products and service categories Understanding of offer preparation, contract negotiation, risk management and commercial and legal terms Traveling mainly within the European Union if needed. Frequent interaction with rail customers and HITACHI Energy European Front-End-Sales Team are expected More about us Our flexible working methods help you optimize your personal and professional performance and create an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.description:

You work closely with experienced colleagues and gain hands‑on experience in development and system configuration. You will learn how digital applications create real business impact. Curiosity, ownership, and a structured mindset will help you succeed. You grow through responsibility, collaboration, and exposure to real projects. How you'll make an impact Develop and enhance IT applications and solutions while contributing to knowledge sharing Support installation maintenance optimization and ongoing operation of IT systems Contribute to application and software design aligned with business requirements Support end‑to‑end development including design build testing and deployment Write clean efficient and maintainable code following best practices Troubleshoot technical issues ensure performance security and scalability Participate in testing quality assurance and continuous improvement activities Document solutions processes and provide technical support to end users Your background Enrolled in IT and Computer Science or similar field (Bachelor or Master) Knowledge of modern application development tools and technologies Experience in at least one programming language (e.g.VB.Net, C#, C++, Microsoft SQL, HTM, Javascript, Python. Specify the languages relevant to the role) Knowledge of development platforms (e.g. AWS, Microsoft Azure, Microsoft DevOps, Visual Studio, Microsoft Power Apps, Microsoft GitHub, Mulesoft, Microsoft BizTalk, Pega, Docker, Kubernetes) Understanding of software development lifecycle and ability to connect technical solutions with business needs Strong analytical and structured thinking More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Unisciti al nostro team IT e contribuire a soluzioni applicative moderne in un ambiente dinamico. In questo ruolo, supporta il ciclo di vita completo delle applicazioni, dalla progettazione alla distribuzione. Lavori a stretto contatto con colleghi esperti e acquisisci esperienza pratica nello sviluppo e nella configurazione del sistema. Imparerai come le applicazioni digitali creano un impatto reale sul business. Curiosità, proprietà e una mentalità strutturata vi aiuterà a riuscire. Crescete attraverso la responsabilità, la collaborazione e l'esposizione a progetti reali. Sviluppare e migliorare le applicazioni e le soluzioni IT, contribuendo alla condivisione delle conoscenze Supporta l'ottimizzazione della manutenzione dell'installazione e il funzionamento continuo dei sistemi IT Contribuire all'applicazione e alla progettazione del software in linea con i requisiti aziendali Supporta lo sviluppo end-to-end, tra cui la progettazione di test e distribuzione Scrivere codice efficiente e manutenbile pulito seguendo le migliori pratiche. Specificare le lingue pertinenti al ruolo) Conoscenza delle piattaforme di sviluppo (ad esempio AWS, Microsoft Azure, Microsoft DevOps, Visual Studio, Microsoft Power Apps, Microsoft GitHub, Mulesoft, Microsoft BizTalk, Pega, Docker, Kubernetes) Comprendere il ciclo di vita dello sviluppo del software e la capacità di collegare le soluzioni tecniche con le esigenze aziendali Forte pensiero analitico e strutturato Più su di noi Siamo una società tecnologica-driven con una forte attenzione all'innovazione, al miglioramento continuo e alla produzione sostenibile.
• Offriamo condizioni di lavoro flessibili, mentorship dedicata, e un ambiente di supporto e inclusivo in cui si può crescere personalmente e professionalmente - consentendo di prosperare mentre bilanciare la vita e il lavoro.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'opportunité Rejoignez notre équipe IT et contribuez à des solutions d'application modernes dans un environnement dynamique. Dans ce rôle, vous supportez le cycle de vie complet de l'application, de la conception au déploiement. Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec des collègues expérimentés et gagnez de l'expérience pratique dans le développement et la configuration du système. Vous apprendrez comment les applications numériques créent un impact commercial réel. La curiosité, la propriété et un état d'esprit structuré vous aideront à réussir. Vous grandissez par la responsabilité, la collaboration et l'exposition à de vrais projets. Comment vous aurez un impact Développer et améliorer les applications et les solutions informatiques tout en contribuant au partage des connaissances Soutenir l'optimisation de la maintenance de l'installation et le fonctionnement continu des systèmes informatiques Contribuer à la conception d'applications et de logiciels conformes aux exigences de l'entreprise Soutenir le développement de bout en bout, y compris la conception de construire des essais et le déploiement Écrire un code propre, efficace et durable suivant les meilleures pratiques Dépanner les problèmes techniques pour assurer la sécurité des performances et l'évolutivité Participer aux tests d'assurance de la qualité et aux activités d'amélioration continue Documenter les processus de solutions et fournir un soutien technique aux utilisateurs finaux Vos antécédents Enregistrés dans les domaines de l'informatique et de l'informatique ou dans un domaine similaire (Bachelor ou Master) Connaissance des outils et des technologies modernes de développement d'applications Expérience dans au moins un langage de programmation (p. ex. VB.Net, C#, C++, Microsoft SQL, HTM, Javascript, Python. Spécifier les langues pertinentes pour le rôle) Connaissance des plateformes de développement (par exemple AWS, Microsoft Azure, Microsoft DevOps, Visual Studio, Microsoft Power Apps, Microsoft GitHub, Mulesoft, Microsoft BizTalk, Pega, Docker, Kubernetes) Compréhension du cycle de vie du développement logiciel et capacité de connecter les solutions techniques aux besoins des entreprises Une pensée analytique et structurée forte Plus à propos de nous Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur la technologie avec un fort accent sur l'innovation, l'amélioration continue et la fabrication durable.
• Nous offrons des conditions de travail flexibles, un mentorat dédié et un environnement favorable et inclusif où vous pouvez vous développer personnellement et professionnellement – vous autonomisant à prospérer tout en conciliant vie et travail.

jobs.title: Umweltspezialist 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position Gestalte aktiv die Zukunft mit – dort, wo Sicherheit und Innovation aufeinandertreffen. Wir suchen eine engagierte und fachkompetente Umweltspezialistin bzw. einen engagierten und fachkompetenten Umweltspezialisten, die\/der unser Bestreben nach einem sicheren, gesunden und nachhaltigen Arbeitsumfeld weiter stärkt. In dieser zentralen Funktion verantwortest du Initiativen zum Schutz unserer Mitarbeitenden, stellst die Einhaltung relevanter Vorschriften sicher und förderst eine proaktive Sicherheits- und Umweltkultur im gesamten Unternehmen. Das kannst du bewirken Sicherstellen der Einhaltung von Umwelt‑ und Sicherheitsvorschriften sowie interner Richtlinien Durchführen von Risiko‑, Gefahren‑ und Umweltanalysen inklusive Ableitung von Massnahmen Planen und Durchführen von internen Audits, Begehungen und Umweltkontrollen Untersuchen von Unfällen und Ereignissen sowie Erarbeitung von Präventionsmassnahmen Mitarbeit an Nachhaltigkeit‑ und Umweltprojekten sowie Förderung der Umweltkultur Erstellen und Durchführen von Schulungen zu Umwelt‑ und Sicherheitsrelevanten Themen Beratung und Unterstützung von Führungskräften und Projektteams bei HSE‑Fragestellungen Zusammenarbeit mit Behörden, Auditoren und externen Partnern Das bringst du mit Abschluss in Umweltwissenschaften, Umwelttechnik, Arbeitssicherheit oder einem vergleichbaren technischen\/naturwissenschaftlichen Bereich (FH\/Universität) Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im HSE oder Umweltbereich, idealerweise in Industrie, Produktion oder technischen Organisationen Fundierte Kenntnisse der Schweizer Arbeitssicherheits- und Umweltgesetzgebung, inklusive relevanter Verordnungen (z. B. Störfallverordnung, Chemikalienrecht, Umweltschutzrecht) Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Risikoanalysen, Gefahrenermittlungen sowie Unfall und Ereignisabklärungen, inklusive Ableitung von Massnahmen Praxis in der Planung, Durchführung und Nachbereitung von Audits, Inspektionen und internen Begehungen, idealerweise gemäss ISO 14001 \/ ISO 45001 Starke Kommunikations- und Beratungskompetenzen für die Unterstützung von Führungskräften, Projektleitenden und Mitarbeitenden in HSE-Belangen Fähigkeit zur Erstellung und Durchführung von Schulungen zu Arbeitssicherheit, Umwelt und Nachhaltigkeit, sowie Analytische Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung im Umgang mit HSE-Kennzahlen, Reporting und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse, weitere Landessprachen von Vorteil Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmodelle helfen Ihnen, persönliche und berufliche Leistung zu optimieren und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem alle Mitarbeitenden ihre Fähigkeiten weiterentwickeln und wachsen können.

descriptionByLocale.it: Attraverso la posizione forma attivamente il futuro – dove la sicurezza e l'innovazione si incontrano. Siamo alla ricerca di uno specialista ambientale dedicato e specializzato o di uno specialista ambientale dedicato ed esperto che rafforza ulteriormente il nostro impegno in un ambiente di lavoro sicuro, sano e sostenibile. In questa funzione centrale, sei responsabile di iniziative per proteggere i nostri dipendenti, garantire il rispetto delle normative pertinenti e promuovere una sicurezza proattiva e la cultura ambientale in tutta l'azienda. Ciò consente di garantire il rispetto delle normative ambientali e di sicurezza nonché delle linee guida interne Condurre i rischi, i rischi e le analisi ambientali, comprese le misure derivanti Piani e l'esecuzione di audit interni, approcci e controlli ambientali Ispezione di incidenti e eventi e lo sviluppo di misure di prevenzione Lavorare con la sostenibilità e progetti ambientali e promuovere la cultura ambientale Questo ti permette di sviluppare continuamente il tuo lavoro con scienze ambientali, tecnologia ambientale, sicurezza del lavoro o simili scienze tecniche/nature (FH\/University) esperienza lavorativa pluriennale in HSE o settori ambientali, idealmente nell'industria, nella produzione o nelle organizzazioni tecniche.
descriptionByLocale.en: Through the position shapes actively the future – where security and innovation meet. We are looking for a dedicated and specialist environmental specialist or a dedicated and expertly-competent environmental specialist that further strengthens our commitment to a safe, healthy and sustainable working environment. In this central function, you are responsible for initiatives to protect our employees, ensure compliance with relevant regulations and promote a proactive safety and environmental culture throughout the company. This allows you to ensure compliance with environmental and safety regulations as well as internal guidelines Conducting risk, hazard and environmental analyses including deriving measures Plans and performing internal audits, approaches and environmental controls Inspecting accidents and events and developing prevention measures Working with sustainability and environmental projects and promoting environmental culture This allows you to continuously develop your work with environmental sciences, environmental technology, work safety or comparable technical/nature sciences (FH\/University) multiannual work experience in HSE or environmental fields, ideally in industry, production or technical organizations.

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un spécialiste de l'environnement ou d'un spécialiste de l'environnement spécialisé et expert qui renforce notre engagement envers un environnement de travail sûr, sain et durable. Dans cette fonction centrale, vous êtes responsable des initiatives visant à protéger nos employés, à assurer le respect des règlements pertinents et à promouvoir une culture proactive en matière de sécurité et d'environnement dans toute l'entreprise. Cela vous permet d'assurer le respect des règlements sur l'environnement et la sécurité ainsi que des lignes directrices internes Effectuer des analyses des risques, des risques et de l'environnement, y compris l'élaboration de mesures Planifier et effectuer des audits internes, des approches et des contrôles environnementaux Inspection des accidents et des événements et élaboration de mesures de prévention Travailler avec des projets de durabilité et d'environnement et promouvoir la culture environnementale Cela vous permet de développer continuellement votre travail avec les sciences de l'environnement, les technologies environnementales, la sécurité du travail ou des sciences techniques/natures comparables (FH\/Université) expérience de travail pluriannuelle dans les domaines de la SSE ou de l'environnement, idéalement dans l'industrie, la production ou les organisations techniques.

jobs.title: Internship in Computational Chemistry 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity The design of high voltage (HV) devices, such as gas circuit breakers (CB) and gas insulated switchgear (GIS), requires – among others –simulations and experiments for verification of insulation and switching performance. Additionally, the research activities in the area of gas circuit breakers are enhanced by various computer-aided-engineering tools. We are looking for an intern student with expertise in computational chemistry to contribute to the development of novel insulating materials for high-voltage power grid applications. The superior goal is the achievement of high-end quality of the product. The duration of the internship is 6 to 12 months.    How you'll make an impact  Contribute to technology development and research activities focusing on material analysis and characterization  Support simulations of gas insulation systems using state of the art computational chemistry packages  Study the relationship between microstructure and material characteristics and document findings and present test results to the team    Your background B.Sc. degree in Material Science, Chemistry, Physics or similar discipline with focus on computer-aided methods  Programming skills and experience in computational chemistry is an advantage  Fluency in written and spoken English  Team player and well organized  Creative and able to work autonomously  Laboratory and experimental experience is a plus  More about us We are a technology‑driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

jobs.title: Cluster Security Manager 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity In this role, you will serve as a recognized subject matter expert in security, providing competent functional support across a country or cluster of countries. You will be responsible for researching, analysing, and interpreting emerging security threats that could impact employees, assets, or operations. You will play a key role in organizational resilience, crisis management, and the implementation of Hitachi Energy's global and regional security strategies. Reporting to the Head of Regional Security, you will manage complex projects with limited supervision, coach lower-level professionals, and contribute to critical business decisions through expert security insights. How you'll make an impact Analyze emerging domestic and international security threats and provide timely assessments and advisories. Deliver competent security support across the country\/cluster, ensuring alignment with regional security standards and KPIs. Ensure compliance through audits, inspections, and monitoring of evolving security legislation. Provide expert security risk management advice to support key business decisions. Drive continuous improvement and behavioural change through global and regional security initiatives. Engage internal and external stakeholders to strengthen security awareness and performance. Lead or support security-related projects, managing objectives, resources, and reporting. Coordinate organizational resilience, emergency response, and country-level crisis management. Your background Min. 5 years Advanced education and significant experience as a security specialist. Proven expertise in threat intelligence, risk analysis, and crisis management. Strong understanding of security standards, legislation, compliance requirements, and audit processes. Experience coaching and advising leaders on security matters within a complex organization. Business fluent in German and English. Demonstrated ability to manage security programs, projects, and budgets effectively. Skilled in stakeholder engagement, communication, and cross-functional collaboration. Experience in organizational resilience, emergency response, and business continuity coordination. Ability to operate in a global matrix environment and manage responsibilities across multiple countries. Approx. 30% Travel required More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione L'opportunità In questo ruolo, sarai un esperto di materia riconosciuta nella sicurezza, fornendo un supporto funzionale competente in un paese o in un cluster di paesi. Sarete responsabili per la ricerca, l'analisi e l'interpretazione di minacce di sicurezza emergenti che potrebbero influenzare dipendenti, beni o operazioni. Si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nella resilienza organizzativa, nella gestione delle crisi e nell'attuazione delle strategie di sicurezza globali e regionali di Hitachi Energy. Segnalando al Capo della Sicurezza Regionale, gestirai progetti complessi con supervisione limitata, professionisti di livello inferiore, e contribuirai a decisioni aziendali critiche attraverso approfondimenti di sicurezza esperti. Come farai ad avere un impatto - Analizzare le minacce di sicurezza nazionali e internazionali emergenti e fornire valutazioni tempestive e consiglieri. - Fornire un supporto di sicurezza competente in tutto il paese/cluster, garantendo l'allineamento con gli standard di sicurezza regionali e i KPI. - Assicurare la conformità attraverso audit, controlli e monitoraggio della legislazione in evoluzione della sicurezza. - Fornire consigli di gestione dei rischi di sicurezza esperti per supportare le decisioni aziendali chiave. - Miglioramento continuo e cambiamento comportamentale attraverso iniziative di sicurezza globali e regionali. - Coinvolgere gli stakeholder interni ed esterni per rafforzare la consapevolezza e le prestazioni della sicurezza. - Guidare o sostenere progetti legati alla sicurezza, gestire obiettivi, risorse e reporting. - Coordinare la resilienza organizzativa, la risposta di emergenza e la gestione delle crisi a livello nazionale. Il tuo sfondo - Min. 5 anni Istruzione avanzata e esperienza significativa come specialista di sicurezza. - Competenza comprovata nell'intelligenza delle minacce, nell'analisi dei rischi e nella gestione delle crisi. - Forte comprensione degli standard di sicurezza, della legislazione, dei requisiti di conformità e dei processi di audit. - Esperienza di coaching e consulenza leader su questioni di sicurezza all'interno di un'organizzazione complessa. - Affari fluenti in tedesco e inglese. - Capacità dimostrata di gestire i programmi di sicurezza, progetti e budget in modo efficace. - Abilitato nel coinvolgimento degli stakeholder, nella comunicazione e nella collaborazione interfunzionale. - Esperienza nella resilienza organizzativa, risposta di emergenza e coordinamento della continuità aziendale. - Capacità di operare in un ambiente di matrice globale e gestire le responsabilità in più paesi. - Approsso. 30% Viaggi richiesto Maggiori informazioni su di noi - Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.
descriptionByLocale.en: ## Descrizione The opportunity In this role, you will serve as a recognized subject matter expert in security, providing competent functional support across a country or cluster of countries. You will be responsible for researching, analysing, and interpreting emerging security threats that could impact employees, assets, or operations. You will play a key role in organizational resilience, crisis management, and the implementation of Hitachi Energy's global and regional security strategies. Reporting to the Head of Regional Security, you will manage complex projects with limited supervision, coach lower-level professionals, and contribute to critical business decisions through expert security insights. How you'll make an impact - Analyze emerging domestic and international security threats and provide timely assessments and advisories. - Deliver competent security support across the country/cluster, ensuring alignment with regional security standards and KPIs. - Ensure compliance through audits, inspections, and monitoring of evolving security legislation. - Provide expert security risk management advice to support key business decisions. - Drive continuous improvement and behavioural change through global and regional security initiatives. - Engage internal and external stakeholders to strengthen security awareness and performance. - Lead or support security-related projects, managing objectives, resources, and reporting. - Coordinate organizational resilience, emergency response, and country-level crisis management. Your background - Min. 5 years Advanced education and significant experience as a security specialist. - Proven expertise in threat intelligence, risk analysis, and crisis management. - Strong understanding of security standards, legislation, compliance requirements, and audit processes. - Experience coaching and advising leaders on security matters within a complex organization. - Business fluent in German and English. - Demonstrated ability to manage security programs, projects, and budgets effectively. - Skilled in stakeholder engagement, communication, and cross-functional collaboration. - Experience in organizational resilience, emergency response, and business continuity coordination. - Ability to operate in a global matrix environment and manage responsibilities across multiple countries. - Approx. 30% Travel required More about us - Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
descriptionByLocale.de:

descriptionByLocale.fr: Descrizione L'opportunité Dans ce rôle, vous serez un expert reconnu en matière de sécurité, fournissant un soutien fonctionnel compétent dans un pays ou un groupe de pays. Vous serez responsable de la recherche, de l'analyse et de l'interprétation des nouvelles menaces à la sécurité qui pourraient avoir des répercussions sur les employés, les biens ou les opérations. Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la résilience organisationnelle, la gestion des crises et la mise en œuvre des stratégies de sécurité mondiales et régionales d'Hitachi Energy. Sous l'autorité du chef de la Sécurité régionale, vous gérerez des projets complexes avec une supervision limitée, coacherez des professionnels de niveau inférieur et contribuerez aux décisions d'affaires critiques grâce à des connaissances spécialisées en matière de sécurité. Comment vous ferez un impact - Analyser les nouvelles menaces à la sécurité nationale et internationale et fournir des évaluations et des avis en temps opportun. - Fournir un soutien de sécurité compétent dans tout le pays/groupe, en assurant l'alignement sur les normes de sécurité régionales et les ICR. - Assurer la conformité par des vérifications, des inspections et la surveillance de l'évolution de la législation en matière de sécurité. - Fournir des conseils spécialisés en gestion des risques de sécurité pour appuyer les décisions clés des entreprises. - Favoriser l'amélioration continue et le changement de comportement grâce à des initiatives de sécurité mondiales et régionales. - Mobiliser les acteurs internes et externes pour renforcer la sensibilisation à la sécurité et les performances. - Diriger ou appuyer des projets liés à la sécurité, gérer les objectifs, les ressources et les rapports. - Coordonner la résilience organisationnelle, les interventions d'urgence et la gestion des crises au niveau des pays. Vos antécédents - Moins de 5 ans Études supérieures et expérience importante en tant que spécialiste de la sécurité. - Expertise éprouvée en renseignement, analyse des risques et gestion des crises. - Une bonne compréhension des normes de sécurité, de la législation, des exigences de conformité et des processus de vérification. - Expérience de l'encadrement et des conseils aux dirigeants sur les questions de sécurité au sein d'une organisation complexe. - Les affaires parlent couramment allemand et anglais. - Capacité démontrée de gérer efficacement les programmes, les projets et les budgets de sécurité. - Compétence en engagement des intervenants, communication et collaboration interfonctionnelle. - Expérience en matière de résilience organisationnelle, d'intervention d'urgence et de coordination de la continuité des opérations. - Capacité de fonctionner dans un environnement matriciel mondial et de gérer les responsabilités dans plusieurs pays. - Env. 30% Voyage requis Plus sur nous - Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance personnelle et professionnelle tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir.

jobs.title: Logistikleiter Warenausgang 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position Bei Hitachi gestalten wir die Zukunft – mit Präzision, Innovationskraft und einem klaren Fokus auf Qualität. Für unsere Produktionsstätte in Wettingen suchen wir eine engagierte und erfahrene Persönlichkeit als Logistikleiter Warenausgang, die mit Überblick und Verantwortungsbewusstsein den gesamten Versandprozess steuert. In dieser Schlüsselrolle stellst du sicher, dass unsere Produkte termingerecht, vollständig und in einwandfreiem Zustand bei unseren Kunden ankommen – und leistest damit einen entscheidenden Beitrag zu unserer Lieferzuverlässigkeit und Kundenzufriedenheit. Das kannst du bewirken Leitung und Koordination aller Aktivitäten im Bereich Warenausgang, einschließlich Kommissionierung, Verpackung, Verladung und Versand Optimierung der Lager- und Logistikprozesse im Warenausgang zur Steigerung der Effizienz und Reduktion von Kosten Führung, Motivation und Weiterentwicklung des Teams im Warenausgang Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Qualitätsstandards, Sicherheitsvorschriften und gesetzlichen Bestimmungen Verantwortung für die Bestandsgenauigkeit im Warenausgang sowie Durchführung regelmäßiger Inventuren Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Abteilungen (Produktion, Einkauf, Vertrieb) sowie externen Logistikpartnern und Spediteuren Analyse relevanter Kennzahlen und Erstellung von Berichten zur Performance des Warenausgangs Identifikation und Umsetzung von Verbesserungspotenzialen sowie Einführung neuer Technologien Sicherstellung einer reibungslosen Abwicklung von Zoll- und Exportformalitäten Dein Hintergrund Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Bereich Logistik, Supply Chain Management oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation (z. B. Logistikfachperson mit eidg. In questo ruolo chiave, assicurarsi che i nostri prodotti raggiungano i nostri clienti in tempo, in pieno e in perfette condizioni, dando un contributo decisivo alla nostra affidabilità di consegna e alla soddisfazione del cliente. Come farete un impatto Gestione e coordinamento di tutte le attività nell'area logistica in uscita, tra cui la raccolta, l'imballaggio, il caricamento e la spedizione Ottimizzazione dei rapporti di magazzino e dei processi logistici in uscita per aumentare l'efficienza e ridurre i costi Leadership, la motivazione e lo sviluppo del team logistico in uscita Garantire la conformità con gli standard di qualità, le normative di sicurezza e i requisiti legali per l'accuratezza dell'inventario e la logistica in uscita, tra cui si effettuano regolarmente
