jobs.title: IT Business Analyst
jobs.description:
The opportunity   Are you passionate about transforming manufacturing environments through smart, data‑driven digital solutions? As an IT Business Analyst for MES and Manufacturing Systems within the BST Grid Integration Application Delivery Team, you will play a key role in shaping the digital backbone of our global factories. You will bridge operational needs with modern technology, enabling efficient, safe, and reliable production processes that support our Grid Integration business. You will work closely with stakeholders, development, and operations to ensure our application landscape delivers maximum business value, innovation, and user satisfaction.      This position is based in Lenzburg with the option for hybrid work. This role offers the opportunity to influence how our manufacturing sites evolve, standardize, and innovate. Even if you do not meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply—your mindset and potential are equally important. A team with great cooperation and with diverse backgrounds is waiting for you to join!   How you'll make an impact   Act as the primary Business Analyst for manufacturing applications , ensuring they meet evolving operational and strategic requirements Collaborate closely with production teams, process engineers, application owners, and global GI stakeholders to collect requirements , define solutions, and secure alignment across all sites Analyze and model processes (e.g., production workflows, quality checkpoints, traceability, data collection), translating them into clear functional and technical requirements for system enhancements or new Manufacturing capabilities Support the full lifecycle of manufacturing applications, ensuring security, compliance, reliability, and integration with critical systems Facilitate workshops, perform gap analyses, lead stakeholder meetings, and create clear documentation to ensure shared understanding and effective decision‑making Identify opportunities to streamline system landscapes , improve data quality, reduce manual work, and strengthen harmonization across factories Drive continuous improvement by monitoring system performance, gathering feedback from users, and proposing enhancements to increase value and efficiency Your Background   Proven experience as an IT Business Analyst, Management Consultant, IT Consultant, or Manufacturing IT Analyst within complex industrial or production environments Strong analytical skills with the ability to understand and model business and manufacturing processes and translate them into actionable requirements Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across diverse teams and cultures Demonstrate experience working with IT\/OT teams, development, operations teams and vendors to deliver high-quality application support and enhancements Experience with MES platforms, industrial data systems, or integration technologies is an advantage, but not mandatory Fluency in English is required More about us 
• We offer a competitive Swiss benefits package designed to support your professional growth and well‑being. Depending on experience and role, this may include: Pension and insurance plans Performance‑based bonus Flexible working arrangements Learning and development opportunities

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità Sei appassionato di trasformare gli ambienti produttivi attraverso soluzioni digitali intelligenti e basate sui dati? Come analista IT Business per MES e sistemi di produzione all'interno del BST Grid Integration Application Delivery Team, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nella modellazione della spina dorsale digitale delle nostre fabbriche globali. Potrai collegare le esigenze operative con la tecnologia moderna, consentendo processi produttivi efficienti, sicuri e affidabili che supportano il nostro business Grid Integration. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con le parti interessate, lo sviluppo e le operazioni per garantire il nostro paesaggio delle applicazioni offre il massimo valore aziendale, l'innovazione e la soddisfazione degli utenti. Questa posizione è basata a Lenzburg con l'opzione per il lavoro ibrido. Questo ruolo offre l'opportunità di influenzare come i nostri siti produttivi si evolvono, standardzzano e innovano. Anche se non si soddisfa ogni esigenza, vi incoraggiamo ad applicare – la vostra mentalità e il vostro potenziale sono altrettanto importanti. Un team con grande collaborazione e con diversi background vi aspetta per unirvi! Migliorare le capacità di produzione, migliorare le prestazioni industriali, migliorare le capacità di sviluppo, migliorare la conformità IT e garantire l'allineamento sicuro in tutti i siti Analizzare e migliorare l'affidabilità dei processi e dei processi (ad esempio, i flussi di lavoro di produzione, i controlli di qualità, la tracciabilità, la raccolta dei dati)
• Offriamo un pacchetto di benefici svizzeri competitivo progettato per supportare la crescita e il benessere professionali. A seconda dell'esperienza e del ruolo, questo può includere: Pensione e piani assicurativi Bonus basato sulle prestazioni Disposizioni di lavoro flessibili

jobs.title: Project Manager GIS High Voltage 80 - 100%
jobs.description: The opportunity Are you driven to create global impact through the leadership of complex, high-value projects? Do you combine strategic thinking with strong execution capabilities? Within Hitachi Energy's High Voltage Product Group, we are shaping the future of power transmission and distribution. In our global Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) business, based in Zürich-Oerlikon, we deliver advanced solutions with the highest standards of reliability and innovation. We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to take ownership of strategically important projects in a global, matrix organization. You will lead cross-functional teams across regions, act as a key interface to international customers, and drive successful project delivery while contributing to continuous improvement and long-term value creation. How you'll make an impact Lead the end-to-end execution of complex, international projects from commercial handover to successful closure, ensuring delivery against scope, timeline, quality, and financial targets Act as the primary interface to global customers, building trusted relationships and leading high-impact engagements, including technical discussions and factory acceptance tests Drive proactive risk and opportunity management, applying a strategic mindset to ensure sustainable project outcomes Maintain full accountability for project performance, including financial steering, resource planning, and forecasting in close alignment with controlling Lead contract execution, including change and claim management, safeguarding both customer satisfaction and business interests Foster cross-functional collaboration and alignment across engineering, manufacturing, and supply chain teams in a global setup Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and actively shape best practices within the project management function Your background Proven track record (7+ years) managing complex projects in an industrial or technology-driven environment, ideally with international exposure Demonstrated ability to lead stakeholders at multiple levels, including senior customer representatives and internal leadership Strong commercial acumen with solid expertise in financial steering, risk management, and contract execution Confident communicator with the ability to influence, negotiate, and present effectively in an international context Experience working in matrix organizations and leading cross-cultural teams Relevant project management certifications (e.g., PMP, IPMA) are an advantage Fluent in German or French; business fluent in English is mandatory More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.description:

jobs.title: R&D Electrical Validation Engineer 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity   In our Product evaluation and qualification team at Hitachi Energy Semiconductors in Lenzburg, we make sure to get to the bottom of things and deliver faultless robust semiconductor chips and power modules through a rigorous qualification process. Our products are delivered to a wide range of customers worldwide for different industrial applications as well as renewable energy, traction, and eMobility. For the extension and strengthening of our testing activities, we look for a highly motivated  R&D Electrical Validation Engineer.   How you'll make an impact   Contribute to development projects for next-generation semiconductor chips and power modules Collaborate with R&D design, process, and product engineering teams Evaluate the performance of new platforms through electrical testing Execute and monitor various electrical tests to ensure product quality Analyze test data and provide technical recommendations Write and review test reports to communicate the key findings to project stakeholders Contribute to continuous improvement of testing activities for customer satisfaction Adhere to safety rules, environmental protection, and laboratory cleanliness and order Your background     Master's degree, or PhD in electrical engineering or a related field with a focus on semiconductor devices or power electronics Few years of experience in electrical engineering, preferably in an R&D environment. Solid understanding of electrical engineering principles, circuit design, and analysis. Familiarity with CAD software for electrical design (e.g., Altium Designer, Eagle, KiCad). Experience with laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, and power supplies. Proficiency in modern software tools (Python, LabView, CAD software, statistical data analysis tools) Fluency in English (written and spoken) More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

jobs.title: Mechanical Designer 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity You will join Hitachi Energy and support technical product development and research activities within a dynamic engineering environment. In this role, you will contribute to the development of Gas-Insulated Switchgear (GIS) components, working closely with cross-functional teams to support innovation and efficient project execution. This position offers hands-on involvement in design processes, exposure to advanced engineering tools, and collaboration across product development and manufacturing functions. How you'll make an impact   Develop and optimize GIS components and assemblies within the GLK-14 project scope Support engineering activities related to HVPLM and SAP systems Prepare, review, and update technical drawings and design documentation Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure design quality and manufacturability Contribute to continuous improvement of design processes and engineering workflows   Your background   Completed apprenticeship as a Mechanical Designer or equivalent qualification Initial experience in mechanical design and technical drawing preparation Familiarity with engineering IT systems (e.g. PLM, SAP) is an advantage Structured and detail-oriented way of working Ability to collaborate effectively within technical teams   More about us At Hitachi Energy, you will be part of an international and collaborative environment, working on innovative technologies that contribute to a more sustainable energy future. This role offers opportunities for continuous learning, development, and exposure to global engineering projects.

jobs.title: IT Application Compliance Manager 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity We are looking for an Application Compliance Project Manager to support the definition, coordination, and execution of our global application compliance roadmap. In this role, you will work closely with the Head of Global IT Compliance and act as a key interface between Business Solution Teams, Global IT Governance, IRM, ServiceNow, and delivery teams. If you enjoy enabling teams, coordinating cross‑functional activities, and contributing to a consistent governance approach across the organization, this opportunity is for you. How you'll make an impact Support the definition and maintenance of the global application compliance roadmap Translate compliance strategy and policy into an actionable delivery plan Coordinate and guide application compliance activities across teams Serve as the primary interface between Business Solution Teams and core IT Drive consistent adoption of Application Lifecylce Management (ALM), Application Onboarding SOP and other compliance relevant instructions Coordinate delivery efforts with Global IT Governance, IRM, ServiceNow, and other teams Track progress, milestones, and cross‑team dependencies Identify risks or misalignments and escalate when needed Your background Strong ITIL background with demonstrated expertise in application management processes and their compliance, risk, and control implications, including experience in IT\/application compliance, assurance, or audit Proven experience in Global IT Governance, enterprise risk management (IRM), and executing cross‑functional roadmaps across multiple stakeholders Solid understanding of ServiceNow workflows and their use within governance, risk, and compliance processes Excellent project, stakeholder, and committee coordination skills, with the ability to organize, drive alignment, and deliver outcomes More about us Hitachi Energy is a global technology leader advancing a sustainable energy future for all. We bring together curious, collaborative people committed to continuous learning and positive impact. Diversity, inclusion, and teamwork are at the core of how we operate. With our innovative technologies and global reach, we support customers and partners in accelerating the energy transition and shaping a more sustainable world.

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire de la conformité des demandes de TI 80 - 100 % (f/m/j)

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità
• Stiamo cercando un responsabile del progetto di conformità alle applicazioni per supportare la definizione, il coordinamento e l'esecuzione della nostra roadmap globale di conformità alle applicazioni. In questo ruolo, lavorerai a stretto contatto con il responsabile della conformità IT globale e agirai come interfaccia chiave tra i team di soluzioni aziendali, Global IT Governance, IRM, ServiceNow e i team di consegna. Se ti piace abilitare i team, coordinare le attività interfunzionali e contribuire a un approccio di governance coerente in tutta l'organizzazione, questa opportunità è per te. Sostenere la definizione e la manutenzione della roadmap di conformità delle applicazioni globali Tradurre la strategia di conformità e la politica di allineamento delle parti interessate in un piano di consegna attuabile Coordinare e guidare le attività di conformità delle applicazioni tra i team Serve come l'interfaccia principale tra i team di soluzioni aziendali e core IT Drive adozione coerente di Application Lifecylce Management (ALM), Application Onboarding SOP e altre istruzioni rilevanti per la conformità Riuniamo persone curiose e collaborative impegnate nell'apprendimento continuo e nell'impatto positivo. Diversità, inclusione e lavoro di squadra sono al centro di come operiamo. Con le nostre tecnologie innovative e la nostra portata globale, sosteniamo clienti e partner nell'accelerare la transizione energetica e plasmare un mondo più sostenibile.

descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Nous sommes à la recherche d'un gestionnaire de projet de conformité aux demandes pour appuyer la définition, la coordination et l'exécution de notre feuille de route mondiale de conformité aux demandes. Dans ce rôle, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec le responsable de la conformité informatique mondiale et agirez comme interface clé entre les équipes de solutions d'affaires, la gouvernance informatique mondiale, IRM, ServiceNow et les équipes de livraison. jobs.title: HSE Specialist 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The Opportunity Join Hitachi Energy as an HSE professional and play a key role in driving a strong health, safety, and environmental culture within our factory operations in Zurich. You will partner closely with leadership and cross-functional teams to ensure compliance, minimize risks, and continuously improve HSE performance while supporting sustainable and safe operations. How You'll Make an Impact Ensure compliance with HSE regulations, internal policies, and Hitachi Energy standards across the factory Conduct risk assessments, audits, and inspections to identify hazards and define mitigation actions Drive incident investigations and implement effective corrective and preventive measures Monitor HSE KPIs, prepare reports, and support data-driven decision-making Deliver and coordinate HSE training sessions while promoting awareness and best practices Support internal, external, and certification audits, ensuring timely follow-up actions Collaborate with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders to integrate HSE into daily operations Lead HSE initiatives and environmental improvement programs (e.g. waste, water, energy) Your Background Minimum 5 years of HSE experience in an industrial or energy environment Degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, Occupational Health & Safety, or similar field Certified HSE professional according to Swiss legislation (mandatory) Strong knowledge of ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 standards and HSE Swiss regulations Proven experience in risk assessments, incident analysis, and performance reporting Strong communication and training skills with the ability to influence behaviors Analytical, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset with a collaborative working style Fluent in German and English; additional expertise in ergonomics or hazardous materials is a plus More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione L'Opportunity Join Hitachi Energy come professionista HSE e gioca un ruolo chiave nella guida di una forte salute, sicurezza e cultura ambientale nelle nostre operazioni di fabbrica a Zurigo. Potrai collaborare strettamente con i team di leadership e interfunzionali per garantire la conformità, minimizzare i rischi e migliorare continuamente le prestazioni HSE, supportando operazioni sostenibili e sicure. Come si fa un impatto - Assicurare il rispetto delle normative HSE, delle politiche interne e degli standard Hitachi Energy in tutta la fabbrica - Condurre valutazioni dei rischi, audit e ispezioni per identificare i rischi e definire azioni di mitigazione - Guidare le indagini sugli incidenti e attuare misure correttive e preventive efficaci - Monitorare i KPI HSE, preparare i report e supportare il processo decisionale basato sui dati - Offrire e coordinare sessioni di formazione HSE, promuovendo la consapevolezza e le migliori pratiche - Sostenere gli audit interni, esterni e di certificazione, assicurando tempestive azioni di follow-up - Collaborare con team interfunzionali e stakeholder esterni per integrare HSE nelle operazioni quotidiane - Guidare iniziative HSE e programmi di miglioramento ambientale (ad esempio rifiuti, acqua, energia) Il tuo sfondo - Minimo 5 anni di esperienza HSE in un ambiente industriale o energetico - Laurea in Ingegneria, Scienze Ambientali, Salute e Sicurezza sul Lavoro, o campo simile - Professionista certificato HSE secondo la legislazione svizzera (obbligatorio) - Forte conoscenza degli standard ISO 14001 e ISO 45001 e HSE - Esperienza comprovata nella valutazione dei rischi, nell'analisi degli incidenti e nel reporting delle prestazioni - Forte capacità di comunicazione e formazione con la capacità di influenzare i comportamenti - mentalità analitica, proattiva e orientata alla soluzione con uno stile di lavoro collaborativo - Fluente in tedesco e inglese; ulteriore competenza in ergonomia o materiali pericolosi è un plus Ulteriori informazioni su di noi - Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.
descriptionByLocale.en: ## Descrizione The Opportunity Join Hitachi Energy as an HSE professional and play a key role in driving a strong health, safety, and environmental culture within our factory operations in Zurich. You will partner closely with leadership and cross-functional teams to ensure compliance, minimize risks, and continuously improve HSE performance while supporting sustainable and safe operations. How You'll Make an Impact - Ensure compliance with HSE regulations, internal policies, and Hitachi Energy standards across the factory - Conduct risk assessments, audits, and inspections to identify hazards and define mitigation actions - Drive incident investigations and implement effective corrective and preventive measures - Monitor HSE KPIs, prepare reports, and support data-driven decision-making - Deliver and coordinate HSE training sessions while promoting awareness and best practices - Support internal, external, and certification audits, ensuring timely follow-up actions - Collaborate with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders to integrate HSE into daily operations - Lead HSE initiatives and environmental improvement programs (e.g. waste, water, energy) Your Background - Minimum 5 years of HSE experience in an industrial or energy environment - Degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, Occupational Health & Safety, or similar field - Certified HSE professional according to Swiss legislation (mandatory) - Strong knowledge of ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 standards and HSE Swiss regulations - Proven experience in risk assessments, incident analysis, and performance reporting - Strong communication and training skills with the ability to influence behaviors - Analytical, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset with a collaborative working style - Fluent in German and English; additional expertise in ergonomics or hazardous materials is a plus More about us - Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
descriptionByLocale.de: Beschreibung Die Gelegenheit gehört Hitachi Energy als HSE-Profi und spielt eine wichtige Rolle bei der Förderung einer starken Gesundheit, Sicherheit und Umweltkultur in unserem Werksbetrieb in Zürich. Sie werden eng mit Führungs- und funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammenarbeiten, um die Einhaltung zu gewährleisten, Risiken zu minimieren und die HSE-Leistung kontinuierlich zu verbessern und nachhaltige und sichere Operationen zu unterstützen. Wie Sie eine Wirkung machen - Sicherstellung der Einhaltung der HSE-Verordnungen, der internen Richtlinien und der Hitachi-Energiestandards im gesamten Werk - Durchführung von Risikobewertungen, Prüfungen und Inspektionen zur Identifizierung von Gefahren und zur Festlegung von Minderungsmaßnahmen - Einleitung von Untersuchungen und Durchführung wirksamer Korrektur- und Vorbeugungsmaßnahmen - Überwachen Sie HSE-KPIs, erstellen Sie Berichte und unterstützen Sie datengesteuerte Entscheidungsfindung - Führen und koordinieren HSE-Trainingssitzungen und fördern das Bewusstsein und die besten Praktiken - Unterstützung interner, externer und Zertifizierungsaudits, um rechtzeitige Folgemaßnahmen zu gewährleisten - Mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams und externen Stakeholdern zusammenarbeiten, um HSE in den täglichen Betrieb zu integrieren - Lead HSE-Initiativen und Umweltverbesserungsprogramme (z.B. Abfall, Wasser, Energie) Ihr Hintergrund - Mindestens 5 Jahre HSE-Erfahrung in industrieller oder energiereicher Umgebung - Grad in Ingenieurwissenschaften, Umweltwissenschaften, Arbeitsmedizin und Sicherheit oder ähnliches Gebiet - Zertifizierter HSE-Profi nach Schweizer Rechtsvorschriften (obligatorisch) - Starkes Wissen über ISO 14001 und ISO 45001 Standards und HSE Swiss Regulations - Erfahrungen in Risikobewertungen, Vorfallanalysen und Leistungsberichterstattung - Starke Kommunikations- und Trainingsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Verhaltensweisen zu beeinflussen - Analytische, proaktive und lösungsorientierte Denkweise mit einem kollaborativen Arbeitsstil - Fluent in Deutsch und Englisch; zusätzliches Know-how in Ergonomie oder gefährlichen Materialien ist ein Plus Mehr über uns - Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen Ihnen dabei, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistungsfähigkeit zu optimieren und eine Umgebung zu schaffen, in der alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptionByLocale.fr: Descrizione The Opportunity Rejoignez Hitachi Energy en tant que professionnel HSE et jouez un rôle clé dans la promotion d'une solide culture de la santé, de la sécurité et de l'environnement au sein de nos usines de Zurich. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec des équipes de direction et des équipes interfonctionnelles afin d'assurer la conformité, de minimiser les risques et d'améliorer continuellement le rendement en matière de SSE tout en soutenant des opérations durables et sécuritaires. Comment vous ferez un impact - Assurer le respect des normes HSE, des politiques internes et Hitachi Energy dans toute l'usine - Effectuer des évaluations des risques, des vérifications et des inspections pour identifier les dangers et définir les mesures d'atténuation - Lancer des enquêtes sur les incidents et mettre en œuvre des mesures correctives et préventives efficaces - Surveiller les ICR HSE, préparer des rapports et appuyer la prise de décisions fondées sur les données - Organiser et coordonner des séances de formation sur l'ESS tout en favorisant la sensibilisation et les meilleures pratiques - Appuyer les audits internes, externes et de certification, en assurant le suivi en temps opportun - Collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles et des intervenants externes pour intégrer le HSE dans les opérations quotidiennes - Diriger les initiatives en matière d'EST et les programmes d'amélioration de l'environnement (p. ex. déchets, eau, énergie) Vos antécédents - Au moins 5 ans d'expérience HSE dans un environnement industriel ou énergétique - Diplôme en génie, sciences de l'environnement, santé et sécurité au travail ou domaine similaire - Professionnel certifié HSE selon la législation suisse (obligatoire) - Forte connaissance des normes ISO 14001 et ISO 45001 et de la réglementation suisse HSE - Expérience éprouvée en matière d'évaluation des risques, d'analyse des incidents et de rapports sur le rendement - Fortes compétences en communication et en formation avec la capacité d'influencer les comportements - Un état d'esprit analytique, proactif et axé sur la solution avec un style de travail collaboratif - Fluent en allemand et en anglais; une expertise supplémentaire en ergonomie ou matières dangereuses est un plus Plus sur nous - Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance personnelle et professionnelle tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir.

jobs.title: Befristet: Automatiker/in 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Über die Position Als weltweit führender Anbieter von Leistungshalbleitern bietet Hitachi Energy eines der vielfältigsten Produktportfolios. Darunter; Thyristoren, Dioden, Gate-Turn-Off-Thyristoren (GTOs), Integrated Gate-Commutated Thyristors (IGCTs), Insulated Gate Bipolar Transistors (IGBTs) und MOSFETs -, die in Industrie, Energieübertragung und -verteilung, Mobilität und erneuerbaren Energien für ihre hohe Qualität und Zuverlässigkeit geschätzt werden. Für unser Team suchen wir befristet eine\/n Automatiker\/in, der\/die beim Aufbau und der Inbetriebnahme unserer Leistungshalbleiter-Testsysteme mitwirkt. Das kannst du bewirken Aufbau von Leistungshalbleiter-Testsystemen inklusive Mechanik, Elektrik, Pneumatik und Hydraulik Durchführung von Anpassungsarbeiten an fehlerhaften Konstruktionen, Fertigungsteilen oder Schemen Kontrolle aller mechanischen, pneumatischen, elektrischen, programmierten und hydraulischen Funktionen Durchführung von Erdungsmessungen (Überprüfung der Durchgängigkeit des Schutzleitersystems nach EN 60204-1 18b) Erstellen von Inbetriebnahme- und Isolationskoordinationsprotokollen Durchführung der Inbetriebnahme und Isolationskoordination von Testsystemen Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Qualitäts-, Sicherheits- und Normvorgaben Aktive Mitarbeit bei der Optimierung von Prozessen und Systemen Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Automatiker\/in EFZ (evtl. mit höherer Fachschule), idealerweise mit Berufserfahrung in der Montage Erfahrung im Projektmanagement Fundiertes Know-how in der mechanischen Bearbeitung von Materialien (Drehen, Fräsen, Bohren, Sägen etc.) Vertrautheit mit Leistungshalbleitern, Messtechnik sowie relevanten Richtlinien und Normen Sicherer Umgang mit Office 365 Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Mehr über uns Befristete Position in einem international führenden Hightech-Unternehmen Abwechslungsreiche und verantwortungsvolle 
• Aufgaben im Bereich Leistungshalbleiter Offene Unternehmenskultur mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen Attraktive Sozialleistungen und moderne Arbeitsmittel

descriptionByLocale.it:
Come leader globale nei semiconduttori di potenza, Hitachi Energy offre uno dei più diversi portfolio di prodotti. Tra questi: Tiristori, diodi, tiristori di gate-turn-off (GTO), tiristori integrati a cancello commutato (IGCT), transistor bipolari a cancello isolato (IGBT) e MOSFET, che sono stimati nell'industria, trasmissione e distribuzione di energia, mobilità e energie rinnovabili per la loro alta qualità e affidabilità. Per il nostro team stiamo cercando un 'automatico' che aiuta a costruire e commissionare i nostri sistemi di prova semiconduttore di potenza. Questo consente di costruire sistemi di prova a semiconduttore di potenza tra cui meccanica, elettrica, pneumatica e idraulica per eseguire lavori di adattamento su costruzioni difettose, parti o schemi di produzione per controllare tutte le funzioni meccaniche, pneumatiche, elettriche, programmate e idrauliche per eseguire misurazioni di messa a terra (controllare la continuità del sistema di scale di protezione secondo EN 60204-1 18b) Questo ti porta con una formazione completa come tecnico automatico (forse con una scuola tecnica superiore), idealmente con esperienza professionale nell'esperienza di assemblaggio nella gestione dei progetti Il know-how finanziato nella lavorazione meccanica dei materiali (torno, fresatura, perforazione, segatura, ecc.) Confidenza con semiconduttori di potenza, tecnologia di misura e linee guida e standard rilevanti Gestione sicura con Office 365 Molto buono tedesco e buona conoscenza inglese in parola e scrittura Più su di noi Posizione limitata in una società high-tech leader a livello internazionale Varied e responsabile
• Compiti nel settore dei semiconduttori di potenza Aprire la cultura aziendale con brevi percorsi decisionali Vantaggi sociali attraenti e risorse di lavoro moderne
descriptionByLocale.en:
As a global leader in power semiconductors, Hitachi Energy offers one of the most diverse product portfolios. Among them: Thyristors, diodes, gate-turn-off thyristors (GTOs), integrated gate-commutated thyristors (IGCTs), insulated gate bipolar transistors (IGBTs) and MOSFETs, which are estimated in industry, energy transmission and distribution, mobility and renewable energies for their high quality and reliability. For our team we are looking for a 'automatic' that helps to build and commission our power semiconductor test systems. This allows you to build power semiconductor test systems including mechanics, electrical, pneumatic and hydraulics to perform adaptation work on faulty constructions, manufacturing parts or schemes to control all mechanical, pneumatic, electrical, programmed and hydraulic functions to perform grounding measurements (checking the continuity of the protective ladder system according to EN 60204-1 18b) This brings you with completed training as an automatic technician (possibly with a higher technical school), ideally with professional experience in assembly experience in project management Funded know-how in mechanical processing of materials (turning, milling, drilling, sawing, etc.) Confidence with power semiconductors, measurement technology as well as relevant guidelines and standards Safe handling with Office 365 Very good German and good English knowledge in word and writing More about us Limited position in an internationally leading high-tech company Varied and responsible
• Tasks in the field of power semiconductors Open corporate culture with short decision paths Attractive social benefits and modern work resources

descriptionByLocale.fr:
En tant que leader mondial des semi-conducteurs électriques, Hitachi Energy offre l'un des portefeuilles de produits les plus diversifiés. jobs.title: Senior Quality Engineer 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity     Hitachi Energy is a global leader in power and renewable technologies that enable utility and industry customers to improve their performance while lowering environmental impact. CHSEM provides high‑power semiconductor devices to Hitachi Energy internal customers (e.g. HVDC, GPQSS) as well as to external customers. The Senior Material Quality Engineer ensures the quality, robustness, and long‑term reliability of critical raw materials used in BiMOS semiconductor device production at the Lenzburg fabrication facility. Acting as a technical authority, the role independently manages complex material‑ and supplier‑related quality topics, contributes to supplier quality strategy, and supports both supplier and team capability development to enable stable and scalable operations. H ow you'll make an impact   Drive the material quality approach for critical raw materials used in BiMOS operations Define and continuously improve CTQ concepts and control strategies Lead complex material quality investigations related to deviations, yield, and reliability issues Monitor & develop supplier performance and ensure effective implementation of corrective actions Lead material qualification, requalification, and change management activities Support production with technical expertise during production, troubleshooting, and ramp-up phases Drive cross-functional improvement initiatives to enhance quality, reliability, and cost efficiency Act as a technical reference, supporting or mentoring engineers and strengthening supplier and team capabilities   Your background   Bachelor's or Master's degree in Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics, or a related field Minimum 5 years of experience in material quality, supplier quality, or semiconductor manufacturing Certified auditor (VDA 6.3, ISO 19011, or equivalent) Strong knowledge of material quality, process control, and risk management in a manufacturing environment Proven ability to independently manage complex material and supplier quality issues Experience with structured quality methods such as 8D, Six Sigma, or equivalent More about us   
• We offer you: Extra days off between Christmas and New Year  Subsidised meals at the locations with canteens 50% discount on main courses at our FELFEL fridges Discount on memberships at various fitness centres  Discounts on various products and services Attractive pension benefits with our company pension fund   Diversity: Promotion of diversity and inclusion and cultural offers, credit cards, petrol, etc.)

jobs.title: Senior Project Engineer - Grid Automation Control & Protection 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity To strengthen our team, we are seeking a Senior Project Engineer with a strong focus on protection systems for substation automation projects. In this role, you will take technical ownership of the Control & Protection scope within complex (sub‑)transmission projects in Switzerland and internationally, acting as a key technical authority from base design through commissioning. You will work closely with project management, customers, and multidisciplinary engineering teams to define, coordinate, and deliver robust protection solutions in line with system requirements, applicable standards, and Hitachi Energy best practices. You will become part of a world-class engineering community within our European Hub, working alongside highly experienced colleagues with deep expertise in the execution of large and complex projects worldwide. This position offers an excellent environment to learn, develop, and actively contribute to Hitachi Energy's purpose of advancing a sustainable, flexible, and secure energy system. It is a unique opportunity to be part of an exciting phase in which electricity is becoming the backbone of a sustainable society. How you'll make an impact Lead and own the Control & Protection engineering scope in substation automation system projects Define protection concepts and philosophies in close collaboration with the technical lead engineering and with customers during the base design phase Coordinate and guide the Protection & Control detailed engineering, ensuring alignment with SCADA, station control, and cyber security disciplines Specify, configure and test protection IEDs in line with customer requirements, grid codes, and standards Support and lead Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) at our test facilities in Baden (Switzerland) Your background Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent, with solid experience in protection engineering for substation automation systems Proven expertise in protection schemes for (sub‑)transmission substations Strong knowledge of IEC 61850 and substation automation architectures Experience with Hitachi Energy Relion® protection IEDs is a strong advantage Able to work independently, take technical decisions, and manage interfaces in complex projects Strong communication skills and a structured, quality‑driven mindset Fluent in English; German is an advantage More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

Questa posizione offre un ambiente eccellente per imparare, sviluppare e contribuire attivamente allo scopo di Hitachi Energy di promuovere un sistema energetico sostenibile, flessibile e sicuro. È un'occasione unica per far parte di una fase emozionante in cui l'elettricità sta diventando la spina dorsale di una società sostenibile. jobs.title: Semiconductor Shift Maintenance Engineer – Implant 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Are you passionate about driving innovation and ensuring maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools? As an Implant Maintenance Engineer\/Technician, you play a vital role in ensuring the availability, reliability, and continuous improvement of our semiconductor production tool park. Your focus is on the corrective, preventive and predictive maintenance of implant equipment, working cross-functionally to drive safety, productivity, and general tool and workflow optimizations across the production line. How you'll make an impact Ensure maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools through proactive maintenance and troubleshooting of implant equipment Drive continuous improvement in equipment performance, applying workplace safety and efficiency practices aligned with 6S methodology Collaborate closely with other maintenance, process, and production teams to achieve performance goals and optimize line efficiency Participate in tool upgrades and modernization projects to enhance tool capability and reliability Maintain accurate and detailed documentation of maintenance activities, equipment status, and system performance Support root-cause analysis and problem resolution for technical issues within the team Train and mentor colleagues in the areas of implant, safety, and best maintenance practices Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations, procedures and documentations Your background Hands-on experience in maintenance of semiconductor production tools Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics and pneumatics Minimum 3 years of experience with ion implanters (such as AMAT or Nissin or Axcelis) Familiarity with metrology tools for process control (Semilab WT-2000) Additional training or expertise in vacuum systems or related technologies Completed technical vocational training (e.g., Automation Technician, Electronics Technician, or similar field) Willingness to work in shifts is a must Strong team player with problem-solving mentality, organizational skills, and proficiency in English (German is a plus) More about us Hitachi Energy offers you interesting tasks in a highly motivated team and an open communication style. Through an individual and practice-oriented induction plan, we will support you to quickly gain professional confidence to be able to work independently with high level of personal responsibility.

Mansioni - Surveiller, analyser et interpréter les données sur le rendement et la qualité afin d'identifier les possibilités d'amélioration et de favoriser des améliorations durables dans les coûts, la qualité et le rendement - Diriger et exécuter des projets d'amélioration en utilisant des méthodologies telles que Six Sigma, Lean Manufacturing, 8D et des cadres connexes - Prendre la pleine propriété du produit après le transfert de R-D, y compris la coordination et la surveillance de la montée en puissance du nouveau produit dans la chaîne de fabrication - Effectuer une analyse des causes profondes et le dépannage des défauts, des faiblesses et des problèmes de qualité des produits, en tirant des conclusions claires sur les lacunes de processus et de conception - Maintenir, améliorer et mettre en oeuvre des méthodes d'acquisition, d'analyse et de rapport de données pour appuyer la prise de décisions fondées sur les données - Ingénieurs en processus de soutien et en R-D possédant une solide expertise technique et des approches structurées de résolution de problèmes
• Requisiti - Maîtrise ou doctorat en physique, génie électrique ou discipline connexe - Une solide expertise en analyse statistique, en méthodes de résolution de problèmes et en techniques avancées d ' analyse des données - L'expérience de fabrication de semiconducteurs est un avantage - Expérience éprouvée menant des projets d'amélioration complexes, idéalement avec de petites équipes interfonctionnelles - Travail confortable dans une organisation internationale, matricielle, avec d'excellentes compétences de communication et de collaboration - Innovant, joueur d'équipe de qualité avec une grande volonté d'apprendre et de s'approprier - Très bonne maîtrise de l'allemand et de l'anglais (écrit et parlé, niveau B2/C1)

jobs.title: Semiconductor Shift Maintenance Engineer or Technician - Diffusion/Implant 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Are you passionate about driving innovation and ensuring maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools? As a Diffusion and Implant Maintenance Engineer\/Technician, you play a vital role in ensuring the availability, reliability, and continuous improvement of our semiconductor production tool park. Your focus is on the corrective, preventive and predictive maintenance of diffusion and implant equipment, working cross-functionally to drive safety, productivity, and general tool and workflow optimizations across the production line. How you'll make an impact Ensure maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools through proactive maintenance and troubleshooting of diffusion and implant equipment Drive continuous improvement in equipment performance, applying workplace safety and efficiency practices aligned with 6S methodology Collaborate closely with other maintenance, process, and production teams to achieve performance goals and optimize line efficiency Participate in tool upgrades and modernization projects to enhance tool capability and reliability Maintain accurate and detailed documentation of maintenance activities, equipment status, and system performance Support root-cause analysis and problem resolution for technical issues within the team Train and mentor colleagues in the areas of diffusion and implant, safety, and best maintenance practices Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations, procedures and documentations Your background Hands-on experience in maintenance of semiconductor production tools Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics and pneumatics Experience with diffusion systems (e.g. ASM, centrotherm ovens) as well as with ion implanters (AMAT, Nissin) Familiarity with metrology tools for process control (e.g., Surfscan, Semilab WT-2000) Additional training or expertise in vacuum systems or related technologies Completed technical vocational training (e.g., Automation Technician, Electronics Technician, or similar field) Willingness to work in shifts is a must Strong team player with problem-solving mentality, organizational skills, and proficiency in English (German is a plus) More about us Hitachi Energy offers you interesting tasks in a highly motivated team and an open communication style. Il vostro focus è sulla corretta, preventiva e predittiva manutenzione di attrezzature di diffusione e impianti, lavorando cross-functionally per guidare la sicurezza, la produttività, e le ottimizzazioni di utensili e flussi di lavoro generali attraverso la linea di produzione. Mansioni - Assicurare il massimo uptime degli strumenti di produzione dei semiconduttori attraverso la manutenzione proattiva e la risoluzione dei problemi di diffusione e impianti - Miglioramento continuo delle prestazioni delle attrezzature, applicazione delle pratiche di sicurezza e di efficienza sul posto di lavoro allineate con la metodologia 6S - Collaborare a stretto contatto con altri team di manutenzione, processo e produzione per raggiungere gli obiettivi di performance e ottimizzare l'efficienza della linea - Partecipare agli aggiornamenti degli strumenti e ai progetti di modernizzazione per migliorare la capacità e l'affidabilità degli utensili - Mantenere la documentazione accurata e dettagliata delle attività di manutenzione, dello stato delle attrezzature e delle prestazioni del sistema - Supporta l'analisi delle cause root e la risoluzione dei problemi tecnici all'interno del team - Collaboratori di formazione e mentore nei settori della diffusione e dell'impianto, della sicurezza e delle migliori pratiche di manutenzione - Promuovere una forte cultura della sicurezza garantendo il rispetto di tutte le normative, procedure e documenti pertinenti

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, is renowned worldwide as a specialist for power transmission and distribution. The Service unit is responsible for the worldwide after sales support of generator circuit-breaker (GCB) systems and gas insulated switchgears (GIS), including training, installation and commissioning, scheduled maintenance, added value services, troubleshooting, extensions, retrofits and replacements. Service is the key to success. As a colleague in our globally active service team, you will appreciate the independent, varied and solution-oriented work. After a versatile, practice-oriented training in Switzerland and abroad, you will lead new GIS installations around the globe. A technically challenging position in a multicultural environment awaits you. You can expect an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow in it. Senior as well as junior applications are welcome! How you will make an impact Managing multicultural construction sites worldwide for gas insulated switchgear for the voltage level of 110KV - 550KV. Responsible for the successful execution of on-site installation \/ maintenance \/ repairs in compliance with contractual deadlines and in compliance with local legal requirements. Responsible for the quality of work performed on site through quality control and assessment of skills of local support staff. Conduct on-site product training on the product and during installation (optional). Coordination of local labor. Cost control of resources used and regular reporting to project management. Actively contribute to process improvements and proactively take measures to increase the efficiency of on-site activities. Your background Completed apprenticeship in the metal construction, electrical or automotive industry, or similar Basic knowledge in electrical engineering is a desirable must, further training in electrical engineering is an advantage Work experience in assembly & commissioning is an advantage Very good German and good English skills, at least B2 Willingness for national and especially international worldwide assignments with up to 90 % travel time Flexible, resilient and communicative team player Flair for pragmatic and unconventional solutions with high quality and safety standards More about us Exciting and varied tasks with great creative freedom Attractive training and development opportunities Interesting and very varied activities\/projects, including off-shore assignments Well-established and dynamic team Open corporate culture An attractive benefits package including fixed, travel and meal expenses, as well as a say in the choice of accommodation

descriptionByLocale.it:

L'unità di servizio è responsabile per il mondo dopo il supporto di vendita di sistemi generatore-rompatore (GCB) e commutatori isolati a gas (GIS), tra cui formazione, installazione e messa in servizio, manutenzione programmata, servizi di valore aggiunto, risoluzione dei problemi, estensioni, retrofit e sostituzioni. Il servizio è la chiave del successo. Come collega del nostro team di assistenza globale, apprezzerete il lavoro indipendente, vario e orientato alla soluzione. jobs.title: Tender and Quotation Specialist 80 – 100% (f/m/d)

jobs.title: Internship Production Development 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity At our BiMOS Backend plant in Lenzburg, Switzerland and Power Semiconductor factory in Prague, Czech Republic, we manufacture efficient, high-quality power semiconductors for use in motor control units, traction applications, industrial applications and inverter systems. In this way, we make a decisive contribution to making industry, public and private transportation more energy-efficient, while our technology also enables the production and transportation of renewable energy from the production site to the consumer. A new production facility is being established in Prague for one of our original equipment manufacturer (OEM) products. This move is motivated by considerations of capacity and business continuity. As part of your Internship in Production Development, you will assist with the transfer of production capabilities from Lenzburg to Prague. You play a vital role in facilitating the introduction and ramp-up of Hitachi Energy Semiconductors products at our second manufacturing site in Prague \/ Czech Republic. 
• Your responsibilities focus on ensuring operational excellence, process integrity, and effective knowledge transfer across locations. How you'll make an impact Supporting the implementation and qualification of new production tools, ensuring they meet performance and reliability standards Assisting with equipment integration as well as the collection and analysis of production and process data Establishing process quality control procedures and corresponding control loops to maintain product consistency and compliance Organizing and supporting training of new production personnel, ensuring effective knowledge transfer from the Lenzburg site to the new factory Supporting product qualification by coordinating production of samples and testing activities Support the implementation of logistical flows for raw materials and processed parts between Lenzburg and Prague Ensuring comprehensive and accurate documentation of processes, work instructions, supporting materials, production tools, and their configurations, to support operational excellence and future audits Your background Study engineering, physics, chemistry, production technology, or related disciplines; holding a bachelor's degree is preferred. The assignment can be part of a master's thesis Show genuine interest in semiconductor backend manufacturing, including areas like innovative processes, logistics, and governance Show effective communication skills for collaborating with diverse stakeholders and cross-functional teams, as well as an interest in international collaboration and knowledge sharing Exhibit attention to detail in documentation and process setup, along with organizational abilities for supporting training, planning, and knowledge transfer Adapt easily to changing environments, embrace new tools, and commit to a six- to nine-month assignment split between Switzerland and the Czech Republic, supporting both operational and developmental activities English at minimum C1 level. Mastering of German is an advantage More about us This internship provides hands-on experience with manufacturing processes and operational excellence in a leading power semiconductor environment. It offers the chance to develop technical and organizational skills while supporting a major industrial expansion across Switzerland and the Czech Republic. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità Nel nostro impianto BiMOS Backend di Lenzburg, Svizzera e Power Semiconductor di Praga, Repubblica Ceca, produciamo semiconduttori di potenza efficienti e di alta qualità per l'uso in unità di controllo motore, applicazioni di trazione, applicazioni industriali e sistemi di inverter. In questo modo, forniamo un contributo decisivo per rendere più efficiente l'industria, i trasporti pubblici e privati, mentre la nostra tecnologia consente anche la produzione e il trasporto di energia rinnovabile dal sito produttivo al consumatore. Un nuovo impianto di produzione è stato istituito a Praga per uno dei nostri prodotti originali per il produttore di apparecchiature (OEM). Questa mossa è motivata da considerazioni di capacità e continuità aziendale. Come parte del vostro stage in sviluppo di produzione, vi aiuterà con il trasferimento di capacità produttive da Lenzburg a Praga. Si gioca un ruolo vitale nel facilitare l'introduzione e la rampa di prodotti semiconduttori di energia Hitachi nel nostro secondo sito di produzione a Praga \ / Repubblica Ceca.
• Le vostre responsabilità si concentrano su garantire l'eccellenza operativa, l'integrità del processo e il trasferimento effettivo della conoscenza in luoghi. Sostenere l'implementazione e la qualificazione di nuovi strumenti di produzione, assicurando loro di soddisfare gli standard di prestazioni e affidabilità Assistendo all'integrazione delle attrezzature, nonché alla raccolta e all'analisi dei dati di produzione e di processo Istituzione di procedure di controllo della qualità e dei corrispondenti loop di controllo per mantenere la coerenza e la conformità del prodotto Organizzare e sostenere la formazione di nuovi personale di produzione, garantendo un trasferimento di conoscenza efficace dal sito di Lenzburg alla nuova fabbrica Il tuo background Ingegneria di studio, fisica, chimica, tecnologia di produzione o discipline correlate; tenere un diploma di laurea è preferito. L'assegnazione può essere parte della tesi di un maestro Mostra un vero interesse per la produzione di semiconduttori, tra cui aree come processi innovativi, logistica e governance Mostra competenze di comunicazione efficaci per la collaborazione con diversi stakeholder e team interfunzionali, nonché un interesse per la collaborazione internazionale e la condivisione delle conoscenze Mostra attenzione ai dettagli nella documentazione e nella configurazione dei processi, insieme alle capacità organizzative per sostenere la formazione, la pianificazione e il trasferimento di conoscenze Adapt facilmente per cambiare ambienti, abbracciare nuovi strumenti, e impegnarsi a un compito operativo di sei mesi in Svizzera a nove Mastering of German è un vantaggio Più su di noi Questo tirocinio fornisce esperienza pratica con i processi produttivi e l'eccellenza operativa in un ambiente semiconduttore di potenza leader. Offre la possibilità di sviluppare competenze tecniche e organizzative, supportando una grande espansione industriale in tutta la Svizzera e nella Repubblica Ceca. Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra domanda, tra cui una breve lettera di copertura e una trascrizione di record, insieme al vostro CV. descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity At our BiMOS Backend plant in Lenzburg, Switzerland and Power Semiconductor factory in Prague, Czech Republic, we manufacture efficient, high-quality power semiconductors for use in motor control units, traction applications, industrial applications and inverter systems. In this way, we make a decisive contribution to making industry, public and private transportation more energy-efficient, while our technology also enables the production and transportation of renewable energy from the production site to the consumer. A new production facility is being established in Prague for one of our original equipment manufacturer (OEM) products. This move is motivated by considerations of capacity and business continuity. As part of your Internship in Production Development, you will assist with the transfer of production capabilities from Lenzburg to Prague. You play a vital role in facilitating the introduction and ramp-up of Hitachi Energy Semiconductors products at our second manufacturing site in Prague \/ Czech Republic.
• Your responsibilities focus on ensuring operational excellence, process integrity, and effective knowledge transfer across locations. How you'll make an impact Supporting the implementation and qualification of new production tools, ensuring they meet performance and reliability standards Assisting with equipment integration as well as the collection and analysis of production and process data Establishing process quality control procedures and corresponding control loops to maintain product consistency and compliance Organizing and supporting training of new production personnel, ensuring effective knowledge transfer from the Lenzburg site to the new factory Supporting product qualification by coordinating production of samples and testing activities Support the implementation of logistical flows for raw materials and processed parts between Lenzburg and Prague Ensuring comprehensive and accurate documentation of processes, work instructions, supporting materials, production tools, and their configurations, to support operational excellence and future audits Your background Study engineering, physics, chemistry, production technology, or related disciplines; holding a bachelor's degree is preferred. The assignment can be part of a master's thesis Show genuine interest in semiconductor backend manufacturing, including areas like innovative processes, logistics, and governance Show effective communication skills for collaborating with diverse stakeholders and cross-functional teams, as well as an interest in international collaboration and knowledge sharing Exhibit attention to detail in documentation and process setup, along with organizational abilities for supporting training, planning, and knowledge transfer Adapt easily to changing environments, embrace new tools, and commit to a six- to nine-month assignment split between Switzerland and the Czech Republic, supporting both operational and developmental activities English at minimum C1 level. Mastering of German is an advantage More about us This internship provides hands-on experience with manufacturing processes and operational excellence in a leading power semiconductor environment. It offers the chance to develop technical and organizational skills while supporting a major industrial expansion across Switzerland and the Czech Republic. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Gelegenheit In unserem BiMOS Backend Werk in Lenzburg, der Schweiz und der Power Semiconductor Fabrik in Prag, Tschechien, fertigen wir effiziente, hochwertige Leistungshalbleiter für den Einsatz in Motorsteuergeräten, Traktionsanwendungen, Industrieanwendungen und Wechselrichtersystemen. Auf diese Weise leisten wir einen entscheidenden Beitrag, um die Industrie, den öffentlichen und privaten Verkehr energieeffizienter zu gestalten, während unsere Technologie auch die Produktion und den Transport erneuerbarer Energien vom Produktionsstandort zum Verbraucher ermöglicht. Eine neue Produktionsstätte wird in Prag für einen unserer Originalausrüstungshersteller (OEM) Produkte errichtet. Diese Bewegung wird durch Überlegungen von Kapazität und Unternehmenskontinuität motiviert. Im Rahmen Ihres Praktikums in der Produktionsentwicklung unterstützen Sie den Transfer von Produktionsmöglichkeiten von Lenzburg nach Prag. Sie spielen eine wichtige Rolle bei der Erleichterung der Einführung und Aufrüstung von Hitachi Energy Semiconductors Produkten auf unserem zweiten Produktionsstandort in Prag \/ Tschechische Republik.
• Ihre Aufgaben konzentrieren sich auf die Sicherstellung operativer Exzellenz, Prozessintegrität und effektiven Wissenstransfer über Standorte. Wie Sie einen Einfluss auf die Implementierung und Qualifizierung von neuen Produktionswerkzeugen ausüben, die Leistungs- und Zuverlässigkeitsstandards erfüllen. Begleitend zur Geräteintegration sowie zur Erfassung und Analyse von Produktions- und Prozessdaten Prozessqualitätskontrollverfahren und entsprechende Regelkreise zur Aufrechterhaltung der Produktkonsistenz und Compliance Organisation und Unterstützung der Ausbildung von neuen Produktionspersonal, um einen effektiven Wissenstransfer vom Standort Lenzburg zur neuen Fabrik zu gewährleisten. Ihr Hintergrund Studieningenieurwesen, Physik, Chemie, Produktionstechnik oder verwandten Disziplinen; ein Bachelor-Abschluss ist bevorzugt. Die Aufgabe kann Teil einer Masterarbeit sein Zeige echtes Interesse an der Halbleiter-Backend-Herstellung, einschließlich Bereichen wie innovative Prozesse, Logistik und Governance Zeige effektive Kommunikationsfähigkeiten für die Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern und funktionsübergreifenden Teams, sowie ein Interesse an internationaler Zusammenarbeit und Wissensaustausch. Mastering of German ist ein Vorteil Mehr über uns Dieses Praktikum bietet praktische Erfahrungen mit Fertigungsprozessen und operativen Exzellenz in einer führenden Leistungshalbleiterumgebung. Es bietet die Möglichkeit, technische und organisatorische Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln und eine große industrielle Expansion in der Schweiz und in der Tschechischen Republik zu unterstützen. Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung, einschließlich eines kurzen Briefes und einer Abschrift von Aufzeichnungen, zusammen mit Ihrem Lebenslauf. Nicht-EU\/EFTA-Bürger, bitte beachten Sie, dass ein offizielles Hochschulzertifikat, das zeigt, dass ein Praktikum ein obligatorischer Teil Ihres Studiums ist erforderlich.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'opportunité Dans notre usine BIMOS Backend à Lenzburg, en Suisse, et dans notre usine de semiconducteurs de puissance à Prague, en République tchèque, nous fabriquons des semiconducteurs de puissance efficaces et de haute qualité pour une utilisation dans les unités de commande de moteurs, les applications de traction, les applications industrielles et les systèmes d'onduleur. De cette façon, nous contribuons de manière décisive à rendre l'industrie, les transports publics et privés plus économes en énergie, tandis que notre technologie permet également la production et le transport d'énergie renouvelable du site de production au consommateur. Une nouvelle installation de production est en cours d'installation à Prague pour l'un de nos fabricants d'équipement d'origine (OEM). Cette évolution est motivée par des considérations de capacité et de continuité des opérations. Dans le cadre de votre stage en développement de la production, vous assisterez au transfert des capacités de production de Lenzburg à Prague. Vous jouez un rôle essentiel pour faciliter l'introduction et la montée en puissance des produits Hitachi Energy Semiconductors sur notre deuxième site de fabrication à Prague \/ République tchèque.

Comment vous aurez un impact Soutenir la mise en oeuvre et la qualification de nouveaux outils de production, s'assurer qu'ils répondent aux normes de performance et de fiabilité Aider à l'intégration des équipements ainsi que la collecte et l'analyse des données de production et de processus Établir des procédures de contrôle de la qualité des procédés et des boucles de contrôle correspondantes pour maintenir la cohérence et la conformité des produits Organiser et appuyer la formation de nouveaux employés de production, assurer le transfert efficace des connaissances du site de Lenzburg à la nouvelle usine Soutenir la qualification des produits en coordonnant la production d'échantillons et les activités d'essai Soutenir la mise en oeuvre de flux logistiques pour les matières premières et les pièces traitées entre Lenzburg et Prague Assurer une documentation complète et précise des procédés, des instructions de travail, des matériaux de soutien, des outils de production et de leurs configurations pour soutenir l'excellence opérationnelle et les audits futurs Votre formation Engineering, physique, chimie, technologie de production ou disciplines connexes; titulaire d'un baccalauréat est préféré. L'affectation peut faire partie de la thèse d'un maître Faire preuve d'un intérêt véritable pour la fabrication de moteurs à semi-conducteurs, y compris dans des domaines tels que les processus innovants, la logistique et la gouvernance Faire preuve d'une communication efficace pour collaborer avec diverses parties prenantes et des équipes interfonctionnelles, ainsi qu'un intérêt pour la collaboration internationale et le partage des connaissances Faire preuve d'une attention particulière au détail dans la documentation et la mise en place des processus, ainsi que des capacités organisationnelles pour appuyer la formation, la planification et le transfert des connaissances. La maîtrise de l'allemand est un avantage Plus sur nous Ce stage offre une expérience pratique des processus de fabrication et de l'excellence opérationnelle dans un environnement de semi-conducteurs de puissance de premier plan. Il offre la possibilité de développer des compétences techniques et organisationnelles tout en soutenant une expansion industrielle majeure en Suisse et en République tchèque. Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature, y compris une brève lettre de présentation et une transcription des dossiers, ainsi que votre CV. Citoyens non-UE\/AELE, veuillez noter qu'un certificat universitaire officiel indiquant qu'un stage est une partie obligatoire de vos études est requis.

jobs.title: R&D Power Semiconductor Chip Engineer 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity   In our R&D BiMOS semiconductor chip groups at Hitachi Energy Semiconductors, we are developing advanced power semiconductor devices across multiple voltage classes. Our high-quality products are manufactured at internal and external production sites and delivered to customers worldwide across a wide range of applications, including industrial, renewable energy, traction, and e-mobility. We are currently looking for a motivated R&D Semiconductor Chip Specialist to contribute to the development of next-generation power semiconductor technologies. In this role, you will focus on silicon-based devices (with strong exposure to power diodes) while expanding towards broader device concepts such as IGBTs and MOSFETs. This position is ideal for candidates with a solid technical foundation in semiconductor device physics and simulation, who are eager to further develop their expertise within a collaborative, high-tech R&D environment. Do you combine a strong technical background in semiconductor device physics with hands-on experience in simulation and technology development? Are you motivated to take ownership of development tasks while continuously learning and growing? Then we look forward to your application. How you'll make an impact Contribute to the development of next-generation power semiconductor chips, with a strong focus on silicon power diodes and related device technologies Support the end-to-end technology and product development cycle, from concept and simulation through to validation and reliability assessment Apply and further develop TCAD simulation models to understand device behavior and optimize performance, yield, and cost Collaborate closely with process engineers, characterization and reliability teams, ensuring alignment between design and manufacturability Take ownership of individual work packages or sub-projects, contributing to overall project goals and timelines Drive continuous improvement through data-driven analysis, modelling, and optimization approaches Actively contribute to knowledge sharing within the team and build a strong systems-level understanding of semiconductor devices and processes Your background   Master's or PhD in Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, with focus on semiconductor device physics Proven experience in power semiconductor device development, ideally with exposure to silicon power diodes Strong hands-on experience with TCAD simulation tools (e.g. Sentaurus, COMSOL) Good understanding of semiconductor device physics, characteristics, and technology development processes Exposure to cross-functional collaboration with process, characterization, and reliability teams Initial experience in owning technical tasks or supervising junior profiles is a plus Familiarity with process integration aspects or modelling approaches is considered an advantage Self-driven, analytical, and eager to learn and grow in a high-performance R&D environment Proficiency in English with strong communication and presentation skills

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione L'opportunità Nei nostri gruppi di chip semiconduttori R&D BiMOS di Hitachi Energy Semiconductors, stiamo sviluppando dispositivi semiconduttori di potenza avanzati attraverso più classi di tensione. I nostri prodotti di alta qualità sono fabbricati in siti di produzione interni ed esterni e consegnati ai clienti in tutto il mondo attraverso una vasta gamma di applicazioni, tra cui l'energia industriale, rinnovabile, trazione ed e-mobility. Siamo attualmente alla ricerca di un motivato R&D Semiconductor Chip Specialist per contribuire allo sviluppo di tecnologie semiconduttori di potenza di nuova generazione. In questo ruolo, ci si concentrerà su dispositivi basati sul silicio (con una forte esposizione ai diodi di potenza) mentre si espande verso concetti di dispositivi più ampi come IGBTs e MOSFETs. Questa posizione è ideale per i candidati con una solida base tecnica in fisica e simulazione dei dispositivi semiconduttori, che sono desiderosi di sviluppare ulteriormente le loro competenze in un ambiente R&D collaborativo e high-tech. Unisci un forte background tecnico nella fisica dei dispositivi semiconduttori con esperienza pratica nella simulazione e nello sviluppo tecnologico? Siete motivati a prendere la proprietà dei compiti di sviluppo durante l'apprendimento continuo e la crescita? Allora non vediamo l'ora della vostra applicazione. Mansioni - Contribuire allo sviluppo di chip semiconduttore di potenza di nuova generazione, con una forte attenzione ai diodi di potenza in silicio e alle relative tecnologie di dispositivo - Supporta il ciclo di sviluppo della tecnologia end-to-end e del prodotto, dal concetto e dalla simulazione fino alla valutazione di validazione e affidabilità - Applicare e sviluppare ulteriormente i modelli di simulazione TCAD per comprendere il comportamento del dispositivo e ottimizzare le prestazioni, la resa e i costi - Collaborare a stretto contatto con ingegneri di processo, team di caratterizzazione e affidabilità, garantendo l'allineamento tra design e manifatabilità - Prendere la proprietà di singoli pacchetti di lavoro o sottoprogetti, contribuendo a obiettivi e tempi di progetto complessi - Miglioramento continuo attraverso l'analisi, la modellazione e l'ottimizzazione dei dati - Contribuire attivamente alla condivisione della conoscenza all'interno del team e costruire una forte comprensione a livello di sistemi di dispositivi e processi semiconduttori
• Requisiti - Master o PhD in Fisica, Ingegneria Elettrica, o un campo correlato, con focus sulla fisica dei dispositivi semiconduttori - Esperienza comprovata nello sviluppo dei dispositivi a semiconduttore di potenza, idealmente con esposizione ai diodi di potenza in silicio - Forte esperienza pratica con strumenti di simulazione TCAD (ad esempio Sentaurus, COMSOL) - Buona comprensione della fisica, delle caratteristiche e dei processi di sviluppo tecnologico dei dispositivi semiconduttori - Esposizione alla collaborazione interfunzionale con team di processo, caratterizzazione e affidabilità - Esperienza iniziale nel possedere compiti tecnici o supervisionare i profili junior è un plus - La familiarità con gli aspetti di integrazione del processo o gli approcci di modellazione è considerata un vantaggio - Self-driven, analitico e desideroso di imparare e crescere in un ambiente R&D ad alte prestazioni - Proficienza in inglese con forti capacità di comunicazione e presentazione Contatto
